*Sports Update*⚽🏀🥊♟️🏆🇳🇬
_Sports Information from the Week_
30.08.2024


(1–13)

1. ⚽ *Edo Queens* have been rewarded with *N100 million* for winning the 2024 WAFU B CAF Women’s Champions League qualifiers. Edo State Governor, Godwin Obaseki, made the announcement during a grand reception for the team in Benin City.. “I congratulate you, girls. I encourage you to win the CAF Champions League. I will not disclose what I will do for you yet, but for what you have done, you have made us proud, and you have made Nigeria proud. So, I give you all one hundred million naira.”.. Moses Aduku’s team defeated the Beninoise side Ainonvi FC 3–0 in the final at the Stade de la Paix last Sunday. Edo Queens will compete in the *CAF Women’s Champions League* later in the year.

2. ⚽ Last weekend... In the EPL, Arsenal, Tottenham, Man City, Chelsea, and Liverpool all had wins. Man United lost to Brighton (2–1). City's 4–1 win vs Ipswich and Chelsea's 6–2 win vs Wolves, were the most beautiful games. City's *Erling Haaland* scored a hat-trick once again, while Chelsea's *Noni Madueke* scored his first hat-trick for the club with *Cole Palmer* having a hat-trick of Assists. Other teams in Europe that had wins include: Real Madrid, Barcelona, Atlético Madrid, Napoli, Bayern Munich, Dortmund, Bayer Leverkusen, Inter Milan, Juventus, PSG. PSG have been impressive in their first 2 games, with outstanding wins (4–1, 6–0), despite Kylian Mbappé's departure.

3. ⚽ Here are some stats from the week: (a) *Erling Haaland* has now scored against all 23 clubs he has faced in the EPL (b) *Endrick* has become the youngest Real Madrid player to score on his La liga debut in the 21st century (18 years and 35 days), and the fifth overall in this period in the competition (c) In the 2024 calender year, Chelsea's *Cole Palmer* have the most G+A in the EPL (24) (d) Chelsea's *Enzo Maresca* is the first manager in EPL history to see his team score 6 goals in his first away game in the competition! (e) *Arne Slot* is the first Liverpool manager to win each of his first 2 EPL games in-charge of the club (f) *Pep Guardiola* has rewarded each member of his first team support staff with a £10,000 bonus as a token of appreciation for their efforts last season👏🏻

4. 🇳🇬 💔 Sad one for Nigerian Football as *Heartland FC* were involved in a ghastly accident last Saturday. The accident happened on the way to Abakaliki for the Ifeanyi Ekwueme TICO/SELECT Pre-season Tournament. The head coach from last season, Christian Obi lost his life in the accident.

5. 🇳🇬 German Manager, *Bruno Labbadia*, has been appointed as the new head coach of the Super Eagles (the 37th Super Eagles coach) . It is his first national team job. His career win percentage is 43.94%. He has coached Hamburg, Stuttgart, Wolfsburg, and Bayer Leverkusen. As a player, he was a striker who scored 229 goals in 609 appearances.

6. 🇳🇬 The first International break of the season comes up immediately after the league games this weekend. European Club football (Men's) will temporarily be on hold as the players travel to represent their various national teams in International games (friendlies, qualifiers). The *Super Eagles squad list* for the AFCON 2025 Qualifiers vs Benin Republic and Rwanda on September 7 and 10, was released within the week. The Super Eagles will be up against the Cheetahs of Benin Republic at the Godswill Akpabio Stadium in Uyo on Saturday, 07/09, before flying to Kigali to take on the Amavubi at the Amahoro Stadium on Tuesday, 10/09.

7. 🥊 *Anthony Joshua AJ* will challenge to become boxing’s fifth three-time heavyweight champion when he steps through the ropes for a domestic dust-up with fellow Brit and newly-crowned champion *Daniel Dubois*. Whilst many are arguing that the card itself is the strongest to ever take place on British soil, there is a more official record that now appears set to be broken when ‘AJ’ and Dubois collide. More than 100,000 spectators is expected to watch the game live. It will take place on September 21.

8. Throwback: Remember *Rory John Delap*? He has more EPL Assists from throw-in situations (5) than any player on record (since 2007/08 season). He made defenders put the ball out for a corner rather than a throw😂. Rory John Delap (now 48 years old and retired) played as a midfielder. He played for clubs such as Derby County, Southampton, Stoke City.

9. 🇳🇬 Former Super Eagles Chief Coach, *Samson Siasia*, has spoken about his journey to clear his name after being banned for five years over alleged match-fixing. Speaking at an event organised by his committee of friends, primarily parents of young footballers in the Siaone Soccer Academy, Siasia shared his journey from growing up in Ajegunle to becoming a renowned football coach and why it was necessary to clear his name... He said it was painful that not even the NFF, affiliated with FIFA, informed him that he was under investigation until the world football governing body banned him.. Siasia stressed that he still doesn’t know how bribery came into the picture.. “I didn’t steal, fix matches, or take bribes,” the Beijing Olympic Silver medal-winning coach insisted. “I was charged, investigated, tried, and sentenced without my knowledge. I was not coaching Nigeria, not managing any other country, and not a football agent when I was banned.”...see more on: www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/728692-my-five-year-journey-to-clear-my-name-siasia.html

10. Last week, we shared that *Cristiano Ronaldo* @cristiano, broke a youtube record by reaching 10 million subscribers in less than 12 hours and 21 million in a day. Few days ago, CR7 reached *50 million youtube subscribers*, and this was achieved in *less than a week*! crazy right?

11. ⚽ The draws for the *Carabao Cup* third-round ties took place this Wednesday. The fixtures will take place in the weeks commencing 16 & 23 September, with UCL and UEL fixtures also scheduled during this period. Some of the fixtures are: Liverpool v West Ham, Manchester City v Watford, Arsenal v Bolton, Manchester United v Barnsley, Chelsea v Barrow.

12. 🏆 The draws for the *2024/25 UCL* Group stages took place yesterday. Remember that the UCL now have a new format, with 36 teams involved (as against 32 previously). Each of the *36 teams* will have to face 8 different clubs (4 home & 4 away). Each team will play against 2 opponents from each pot. There is one single table for all 36 teams, taking a league table format. The top 8 automatically qualifies for the R16. 9th to 24th would play a 2 legged KO and the 8 victors would progress to R16. Then, the normal 2 legged progression goes on till the finals. *Cristiano Ronaldo* was also honored with a special award as the UEFA Champions League All-Time Top Scorer. He made 183 appearances, scoring 140 goals, and winning 5 UCL trophies.

13. ⚽ The *Summer Transfer Window* ends today by 11 pm UK time. After today, clubs in Europe cannot sign players from other European leagues till the Winter Windrow in January. Only free agents may be possible.. *League football* continues this weekend.. the more interesting games we could look out for are: Inter v Atalanta (today), Man United v Liverpool (Sunday), Juventus v Roma (Sunday), Lille v PSG (Sunday). Chelsea, Tottenham, Newcastle, Real Madrid plays on Sunday. Man City, Arsenal, Barcelona plays on Saturday.

📍It's the largest gathering of Pharmacists in Edo State, and it takes place once in a year.

📍 It brings together all the Technical and Interest Groups of PSN Edo State – AHAPN, ACPN, NAIP, NAPA, PSN Board of Fellows, PSN-YPG, ALPS, CPAN.

📍It's an opportunity to network with colleagues and senior professionals from the various technical and interest groups.

[04/09/2024, 18:19:33] Surge: Young Pharmacists Group (YPG) Executives Pay Courtesy Visit to PSN Chairman, Edo State Chapter 🚀⚡️

On September 3rd, 2024, the executives of the Young Pharmacists Group (YPG), Edo State Chapter, paid a courtesy visit to the Chairman of the Pharmaceutical Society of Nigeria (PSN), Edo State Chapter, Dr. Chris Oisakede.

The YPG executive committee was represented by the Coordinator, Pharm. Osarodion Edomwonyi, Deputy Coordinator, Pharm. Osamuyi Efemena, and Public Relations Officer, Pharm. Osakpolor Ogiemudia.

This visit was both pivotal and timely, as the YPG executives outlined several strategic plans, focusing on the welfare of young pharmacists in Edo State.

Dr. Chris Oisakede encouraged young pharmacists to actively participate in pharmacy-related activities within the state and to stand firm in protecting the profession from any undermining forces.

*Sports Update*⚽🏀🥊♟️🏆🇳🇬
_Sports Information from the Week_
06.09.2024

> The ongoing FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup; the 2024 Paralympics; the 2024 Ballon d'Or awards; European football leagues; Africa; Nigeria..


(1–12)

1. ⚽🇳🇬 The *FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup* kicked-off last Saturday (31 August). In their first game (early Monday morning), the *Falconets* of Nigeria defeated Korea Republic (1–0) through a spectacular 84th minute goal by Flourish Sabastine. Falconets star, Philomina Addo Yina claimed the Player of the Match (POTM) award. The second game on Wednesday saw the Falconets lose (3–1) to Germany. The last game of the group stage is *tomorrow* vs Venezuela. A win (or draw) can secure progression to the KO depending on the result of Germany vs Korea, which will be played simultaneously (9 pm).

2. 🇳🇬 Last weekend, the newly appointed Super Eagles coach, *Bruno Labbadia*, rejected his appointment just three days after being unveiled by the Nigerian Football Federation (NFF). The NFF has announced that *Augustine Eguavoen*, a former player and Technical Director of the Super Eagles, will step in as the head coach for the team’s 2025 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifiers against Benin Republic (7th) and Rwanda (10th). Remo Stars coach, *Daniel Ogunmodele*, and Rangers coach, *Fidelis Ilechukwu*, have been invited to assist coach Eguavoen. The invited Super Eagles players are currently in camp preparing for their game tomorrow against Benin Republic at the Godswill Akpabio Int'l Stadium, Uyo, Akwa Ibom State (5 pm).

3. The *2024 Summer Paralympics* (the 17th edition) kicked-off last Wednesday (28 August). As at yesterday (Thursday) evening, the medals table have *China* on top with 166 medals (74, 55, 37). Other top medalists are: Great Britain with 84 medals (36, 29, 19), United States with 77 medals (27, 33, 17), France (61), Italy (54), Ukraine (61), Brazil (62), Australia (45), Netherlands (36). *Nigeria* have only *2 medals* (1 Silver, 1 Bronze). The Paralympics ends this Sunday. It's crazy the level of excellence China has shown in both the Olympics and the Paralympics.

4. 🥉 Nigerian teenager, *Mariam Eniola Bolaji*, on Monday, became the first player from Africa to win a medal in *badminton* at the Paralympic games. The 18-year old beat Ukraine's Oksana Kozyna to claim the para badminton *bronze medal* in the women's SL3 category for players with moderate limitation of movement to one side or in both legs, or missing limbs. On Wednesday, in the women's 41kg powerlifting event, *Esther Nworgu* won *silver medal*.

5. ⚽ *Erling Haaland* scored a hat-trick in consecutive EPL games and now have 7 EPL goals (3 games) this season! He has also scored *69 goals in 69 EPL games* since he joined City. Haaland has scored *8 EPL hat-tricks* in less games (69) compared to 326, 320, and 258 games by Michael Owen, Harry Kane, and Thierry Henry, respectively. He has *97 goals in 102 games* with Man City. The current fastest player to score 100 goals for a club is Cristiano Ronaldo in 105 games for Real Madrid. Haaland needs to score 3 goals in the next 2 games to break the record. He has been nominated for the EPL Player of the Month (August) which he is most likely to win. He's also nominated for the 2024 Ballon d'Or.

6. ⚽ *Bayer Leverkusen*'s 35-game unbeaten run in the Bundesliga came to an end last Saturday, after a 3–2 loss to RB Leipzig, despite being ahead 2–0 at 45 minutes. This is Leverkusen's first loss in the league since 27 May 2023 when they lost 3–0 to VfL Bochum 1848. It's the first league loss Granit Xhaka is experiencing in the team, since he joined last summer.

7. ⚽ Liverpool had a comfortable win at Old Trafford last Sunday, defeating Man United 3–0, with *Mohamed Salah* assisting two and scoring one. The win ensures that only *Man City* and *Liverpool* have 9 points, with Liverpool yet to concede a goal in the EPL this season. Mo Salah have now scored 15 goals and assisted 6 in 15 games against United.

8. ⚽ Last weekend... *Mason Greenwood*, who moved to Marseille from Man United, have scored 5 goals in his first 3 league games.. *Romelu Lukaku* also scored a goal in his debut for Antonio Conte's Napoli.. In La liga, *FC Barcelona* defeated Valladolid 7–0, maintaining a 100% win record in La liga after 4 games (12 points) and top of the league with 4 points. Hansi Flick is cooking! Raphinha scored a hat-trick in the game. In Bayern's 2–0 win last weekend, *Thomas Müller* broke the record for the most Bayern Munich appearances in history (710).

9. ⚽ Heading into the International break... only Luis Enrique's *PSG* in Ligue 1 (France), have a 100% record with 3/3 wins (9 points). In the Bundesliga (Germany), Vincent Kompany's *Bayern Munich* have had a good start with 2/2 wins so far. In the Eredivisie (Netherlands), *PSV Eindhoven* have a perfect start of 4/4 wins (12 points). In Serie A (Italy), no team have a 100% record, but *Inter Milan*, *Juventus*, *Torino* and *Udinese* have 7 points each (2 wins + 1 draw).

10. ⚽ There was a transfer saga with *Victor Osimhen*. He is not part of Antonio Conte's plan for this season and was to have left Napoli before the EPL transfer window ended last Friday. He couldn't leave for a Al Ahli (issues with Napoli reaching an agreement with the Saudi club) or Chelsea (wage offer is less than current wage). On Monday, he finally secured a one season loan move to Turkish club, *Galatasaray*. The agreement will see his release clause drop down to €75m from 2025, making it easier for other big clubs to sign him from the next transfer window. Victor Osimhen has now parted ways with his agent Roberto Calenda after failing to secure a move to either Al Ahli or Chelsea. He personally negotiated his loan move to Galatasaray with the help of an intermediary, George Gardi.

11. 🏆 The Nominees for the various categories of the *2024 Ballon d'Or* awards were released on Wednesday. The *Kopa Trophy* (won by Jude Bellingham last year) has Lamine Yamal, Savinho, among others shortlisted. Barcelona's *Lamine Yamal* is the most likely winner this year. *Emiliano Martínez*, the winner of last year's Yachine Trophy (best GK) is also nominated this year, with the likes of Unai Simon, Ronwen Williams, Andriy Lunin, among others, nominated. The *Coach of the Year* have the coaches of Real Madrid, Atalanta, Bayer Leverkusen, Man City, Argentina and Spain, nominated. The Nominees for the *Women's Ballon d'Or* award have the likes of Aitana Bonmati, Alexia Putellas, Lauren James, Salma Paralluelo, Lucy Bronze, among others. The big one, the *Men's Ballon d'Or* have the likes of Vinicius Junior, Jude Bellingham, Kylian Mbappé, Lamine Yamal, Cole Palmer, Erling Haaland, Bukayo Saka, *Ademola Lookman*, among others. The Ballon d'Or awards/ceremony takes place on *October 28*, in Paris, France.

12. The *2024 Ballon d'Or* ... (a) Nigeria and Atalanta's *Ademola Lookman* is the only African player to be nominated this year. He's the 8th Nigerian to be nominated for the Men's Ballon d'Or (b) For the first time since 2003, both *Lionel Messi* and *Cristiano Ronaldo* are not nominated. CR7 was nominated for 18 Ballon d'Ors, while LM10 was nominated for 16. It's truly the end of an era (c) *Lamine Yamal* is the youngest ever player in history to be nominated for the Ballon D'Or (17 years) (d) South Africa's *Ronwen Williams* is the first goalkeeper in history to be nominated for the Yachine Trophy while playing for a club in Africa (he plays for South Africa and the top club in the South African league).

🇰🇵 North Korean hackers are intensifying their attacks on the crypto industry with a new Android malware, SpyAgent, warns the FBI. 

🔎 Discovered by McAfee, this sneaky malware steals private keys by scanning screenshots and images on your phone using optical character recognition (OCR).

🛡 How it works:

▪️ Malicious links in texts direct you to fake, seemingly legitimate sites.

▪️You download an app disguised as a banking or streaming service.

▪️The app requests permissions to access your contacts, messages, and local storage, then starts stealing your private keys from images.

Currently targeting South Korean users, SpyAgent is found in over 280 fake apps. Stay vigilant and avoid downloading apps from unverified sources! 🕵️‍♂️🔒 ‎image omitted

[10/09/2024, 09:51:53] Dr Maurice GSK: We need to learn the art of negotiation.

We are focused on only salaries that we lose sight of other avenues to raise funds.

After negotiating your salaries. 

You should also negotiate extra allowances that will be of benefit to you and also the Pharmacy. 

That's where your consultation fees comes in. 

Asking for consultation fees means you should also be clinically sound.

If out of 10 consults, 8 of them still end up going to the hospital, then you have no moral right to demand consultation fees.

You also negotiate Short Dated products. How much percentage will you earn when you push Short dated products.

You should also negotiate, how much you earn if you increase the sales as agreed.


That's where you make money in community Pharmacy.

Anytyn I say, I speak from experience.

My Locum salary I didnt touch it because I was always winning incentives.

You can achieve same too 👍🏾.

*Sports Update*⚽🏀🥊♟️🏆🇳🇬
13.09.2024

> Sports Stories & throwbacks, The International break; the ongoing FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup; the 2024 Paralympics; FIBA U-18 Afrobasket Tournament; the NPFL; European football leagues; Africa; Nigeria..


(1–13)

1. 🗣️ *Edin Džeko*:  “My mother saved my life when I was a child. She did not let me go and play football with my friends in Bosnia.. A few minutes later, a bomb exploded on the spot and killed my friends. I didn't have a childhood because of the war but all that made me stronger”... Everyone have a story; a bitter side masked by the happy and beautiful scenes we see. It's the same with successful sports men and women. *Edin Džeko* is a 38-years old professional footballer, and has played for clubs such as: VfL Wolfsburg (Germany), Manchester City (England), AS Roma, Inter Milan (Italy), Fenerbahçe (Turkey), etcetera. He also plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.

2. ⚽ Taking a throwback to history... On *8 September 1888* (136 years ago), the first ever football league matches took place. The founding members are: Accrington, Aston Villa, Blackburn, Bolton, Burnley, Derby, Everton, Notts County, Preston, Stoke, West Brom and Wolves. You see how old these clubs and many other football clubs are. Incredible!

3. 🗣 - The Brazilian hacker Lucas who stole *Neymar*'s bank account in 2022: "I apologize to Neymar for what I did, but it was a failure of the bank and it's not my fault.. "Will you return the money to Neymar?".. "What money? Neymar... I apologize to him for what I did, but he doesn't ask me for anything. If he wants his money, he should file a lawsuit against the bank, as they are the ones who have failed systems. As for the money, I invested it and bought a house." Crazy🤣

4. 🇳🇬 Last Saturday was a great day for Nigeria in football. The *Super Eagles* won Benin *3–0* in their first game of the AFCON 2025 Qualifiers, at the Godswill Akpabio Int'l Stadium, Uyo, Akwa Ibom State. The victory placed them top of the qualification Group D, after Rwanda and Libya played out a 1–1 draw in their first game. *Ademola Lookman* scored twice with Victor Osimhen scoring once. Praises were given to the coaching team of the Super Eagles led by *Augustine Eguavoen*. In many's opinion, he's probably a more deserving coach than Finidi George, for the Super Eagles job. Recall that Nigeria had lost 2–1 to Benin in June, in the 2026 World Cup Qualifiers. Nigeria, Benin and Rwanda are in same qualification groups in both the AFCON and the World Cup.

5. 🇳🇬 Same Saturday, the *Falconets* won Venezuela *4–0* in their last group stage game of the *U-20 Women's World Cup*. They finished runner-up in Group D, with Germany U20 finishing as Group D winners, but with same 6 points as the Falconets, after they lost their last game to South Korea 1–0.. In the early hours of today, the Falconets played their *R16 fixture* vs Japan, where they lost (2–1) and are now out of the World Cup.

6. 🇳🇬 Victor Osimhen's goal tally for the national team is now at *22 Goals*. He is 15 goals behind Nigeria's all time top scorer, Rashidi Yekini who finished with *37 goals*. We look forward to Osimhen breaking Yekini's record... On Tuesday, the Super Eagles played out a *goalless draw* vs Rwanda. They still top Group D with 4 points and now hope to get more points in the October's International break.

7. 🇳🇬⚽ *Can Nigeria still qualify for World Cup 2026?* Yes, Nigeria can still reach the finals to be staged across the United States, Canada and Mexico. All is not lost just yet, although there is a fast-closing window of opportunity. The Super Eagles lie fifth in the six-team Group C on 3 points. On the face of it, that's a dismal state of affairs, but they are only four points behind second-place South Africa. In turn, Bafana Bafana are only behind leaders Rwanda on goal difference. Nigeria have *six games remaining* to turn the ship around, with teams playing one another home and away during the group phase. The winners of CAF's nine groups qualify automatically for the World Cup, with the four best runners-up entering the playoff route.

8. 🇳🇬 Nigeria’s *Onyinyechi Mark* shattered the Paralympic record in the *women’s 61kg powerlifting* category, lifting an astounding 145kg. The remarkable feat surpassed the previous record held by compatriot Lucy Ejike. Mark’s performance has all but secured Nigeria’s *first gold medal* at the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games. In addition, *Isau Ogunkunle* (para-table tennis bronze), *Bose Omolayo* (para-powerlifting silver), and *Flora Ugwunwa* (women’s javelin silver) were all on the podium last Saturday. Nigerian powerlifter, *Folashade Oluwafemiayo*, won gold medal in the women’s over 86kg, where she broke a world record becoming the first to lift 167kg.

9. The 2024 Paralympics came to an end last Sunday. *Nigeria* finished with a total of *7 medals* (2G, 3S, 2B). We finished 40th overall on the medals table, 4th in Africa, behind Algeria, Tunisia and Morocco. *China* finished with 220 medals (94G, 76S, 50B). *Great Britain* finished with 124 medals (49G, 44S, 31B). *United States* finished with 105 medals (36G, 42S, 27B). Other top medalists are: Netherlands, Brazil, Italy, Ukraine, France, Australia, Japan, Germany.

10. 🇳🇬🏀 Nigeria’s *Junior* D’Tigress (female) and D’Tigers (male) qualified for the round of 8 at the ongoing *2024 FIBA U-18 Afrobasket Tournament*. It's the first time that two Nigerian teams would get into the quarter-finals at that level. Both teams are expected to represent Africa in the *FIBA U18 World Cup* scheduled to take place in Switzerland.. *D’Tigress* further progressed to the *semifinals*, after defeating Egypt (66–51), where they'll face Uganda today.. Nigeria’s Junior *D’Tigers*, also booked a spot in the quarterfinals of the ongoing FIBA 2024 U-18 Afrobasket after defeating Uganda (72–61), but lost the quarterfinal to Mali (81–70) yesterday.. The tournament which started on 1 September will end tomorrow, 14 September.

11. ⚽ *San Marino* (Europe) – the team ranked 210th and last in the FWR have won a *competitive* football match for the first time in their history, beating 199th-ranked, Liechtenstein 1–0 in a Nations League game last week Thursday! San Marino’s goalscorer and matchwinner, Nicko Sensoli, was not even born the last time they won a game – and even that was only a friendly, also 1–0 vs Liechtenstein in April 2004. Back then, CR7 had only scored a career total of 9 goals. Now, CR7 have a career total of 900+ goals. Between April 2004 and this win, San Marino had 171 losses and 5 draws (0W, 5D, 171L).

12. ⚽ Outside Africa (AFCON Qualifiers), the International break featured a lot of *football games in other continents*. The *South America* and *Asia* continents featured 2026 World Cup qualifying games. Argentina won Chile (3–0), but lost to Columbia (1–0) three days later. Brazil defeated Ecuador (1–0), but lost to Paraguay (1–0) three days later. Brazil is on the verge of missing out of the 2026 World Cup if they get a bad result in the remaining game(s).. The first 2 rounds of the *2024/25 UEFA Nations league* (Europe) also held during this break from club football.

13. 🇳🇬⚽ (a) The *NPFL*, Nigeria's biggest league, resumed earlier in the week. Kano Pillars, Sunshine stars, Enyimba FC, Remo Stars, Niger Tornadoes and Plateau United, all recorded wins (3 points). *Bendel Insurance* of Edo State, along with 7 other clubs had draws. The other 6 teams lost to the 6 winners... (b) FIFA have approved a *new offside rule*. The entire body of the attacker must be in front of the defender for it to be ruled out... (c) *European football leagues* resume this weekend after the September International break. The *2024/25 UCL* also resumes next week (mid-week). Tottenham vs Arsenal is the big one on Sunday in the EPL.


_Share your thoughts and opinions on the Sports Update. Hope you had a good week? Sports is beautiful. Do enjoy your weekend._

*Sports Update*⚽🏀🥊♟️🏆🇳🇬
20.09.2024

> Sports Stories & throwbacks; FIBA U-18 Afrobasket Tournament; the ongoing FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup; the highest paid Women's football player; the UCL; the NPFL; European football leagues; Africa; Nigeria..


(1–13)

1. 🗣️ *Vincent Kompany* (Bayern Munich's head coach and former Man City and Belgium defender and captain) on critics who claimed that the Bayern job was 'too big' for him: "I'll tell you something in a quick way just to prove a point. I was born in Brussels, my dad was a refugee who came from Congo. What are my chances of even playing in the Premier League, winning something as a player, playing for the national team? The odds were 0.000 something. Now I'm a coach. Do you just stop believing in yourself and what you can achieve because of what other people say? The mentality is to keep going and in the end if you fail, you fail [and] if you succeed, you succeed. But you can always become better. Online you can always find stuff [criticism] so I really don't take it personal. What am I supposed to do? Stop because of what other people think? Let's encourage people to succeed and break barriers."❤️ Bayern recorded the one of the biggest of victories in the UCL (on Tuesday night) against Dinamo Zagreb (9–2), becoming the first team to score nine goals in a UCL game.

2. ✨ *Sadio Mané* (plays for Senegal and Al Nassr, and former Liverpool star) refuses to forget his roots. The Senegalese star has spent a lot to improve the quality of life of his childhood village of Bambaly, taking it closer to becoming a town. He donates about €70 per month to each family in his village. In 2018, he spent about €250,000 to build a secondary school, allowing children to continue their education. To encourage students to excel in their studies, he gave $400 to each of the toppers of the high school, alongside a laptop. Unsurprisingly, Mane wishes for the kids to excel in sports and distributes free sportswear in Bambaly. He has also spent over €529,000 to build a hospital in his village. The hospital is not only capable of serving the residents of Bambaly but also a total of 34 neighboring villages. In addition to the school and hospital, he has opened a fuel station and has now built a post office for the welfare of the village’s residents.👏🏻

3. 🏀 Nigeria's *Junior D'Tigress* finished with a *Silver medal* in the FIBA U-18 Afrobasket Tournament, after losing to Mali (76–56) in the final last Sunday. They had defeated Uganda (71–67) in the semi-final last Friday to progress to the final.

4. ⚽ The FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup will be coming to an end this Sunday. Remember that Nigeria got knocked out by Japan last Friday. The Quarter finals saw victories for *North Korea*, *Netherlands*, *Japan* and *USA*.. The semi finals saw North Korea defeating USA (1–0) and Japan defeating Netherlands (2–0). The final on Sunday is *North Korea vs Japan*. It's interesting to note that both finalists are *East Asia* nations.

5. ⚽ FC Barcelona's *Aitana Bonmati*, the Women's Ballon d'Or holder, is now the highest paid Women's footballer after signing a new contract with the club earlier this week. She will earn *€1 million per year* excluding bonuses and endorsement deals. Other top paid players in Women's football are: FC Barcelona's Alexia Putellas (€700,000), Chelsea's *Sam Kerr* (€538,000), FC Barcelona's *Kiera Walsh* (€457,000).. you can observe that the highest paid Women's footballer earns an annual amount that a number of male footballers earn in 1–3 months.

6. 🥊 *Anthony Joshua (AJ)* will challenge to become boxing’s fifth three-time heavyweight champion when he steps through the ropes for a domestic dust-up with fellow Brit and newly-crowned champion *Daniel Dubois*. More than 100,000 spectators is expected to watch the game live (tomorrow, Sept 21).

7. 🟨 Last weekend was an interesting one in league football. In the EPL, the game between Bournemouth vs Chelsea saw Referee Anthony Taylor issue out *14 yellow cards*, the most on record in the EPL. The game between Tottenham vs Arsenal had a record of *7 yellow cards* in the first half! At the end of the game week, a total of *65 yellow cards* were issued out, setting a record of yellow cards in the EPL. Bournemouth and Chelsea have been fined £25,000 each after accumulating at least 6 yellow cards each in that game. Referee Anthony Taylor may have received threats after the game, and this had made the FA to remove him from officiating any game this weekend (he has been appointed as a fourth referee instead for some games).

8. ⚽ *Lionel Messi* marked his return from a 2 months injury (since the Copa America) last weekend, by scoring a brace and assisting one in Inter Miami's 3–1 win vs Philadelphia Union. *Inter Miami* are now 4 wins away from the league title.

9. ⚽ *Erling Haaland* scored both goals for Man City in their 2–1 win vs Brentford last Saturday. It took his goal tally in the EPL to 9 goals (4 games), and is now the first to score such after the first 4 games of the EPL season. *Liverpool* lost (1–0) to Nottingham, a loss that ensures that Man City currently tops the EPL.

10. 🇳🇬 *Bendel Insurance* of Edo State is to take on Shooting Stars this weekend, in the *NPFL*, but the game may have been postponed. They lost away to Katsina United last weekend, and have only 1 point in the league from 2 games (1D, 1L). *Remo Stars* are currently top after 2/2 wins.

11. ⚽🇳🇬 The likes of Victor Boniface and Ademola Lookman among others, were impressive for their clubs last weekend. *Victor Boniface* was the star performer in Bayer Leverkusen's 4–1 win vs Hoffenheim, where he scored a brace and assisted one. *Ademola Lookman* was the star performer in Sunday's game between Atalanta vs Fiorentina (3–2), where he scored a goal and assisted one.

12. ⚽ The first games of the league phase of the *UCL* took place on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. 18 games were played with interesting results obtained. The most notable result was *Bayern Munich*'s 9–2 win vs Dinamo Zagreb which took them to the top of the league. The +7 GD is participating smart, as goal differences will have a huge role to play in this new format of the UCL especially when two teams finish with the same points.

13. ⚽ League football continues this weekend. Some of the interesting games are: Juventus vs Napoli, *Man City vs Arsenal*, Villarreal vs Barcelona, Inter Milan vs AC Milan, Lyon vs Marseille..


_Share your thoughts and opinions on the Sports Update. Hope you had a good week? Sports is beautiful. Do enjoy your weekend._

Monday Okpebholo, a Nigerian politician and business man was born on 29 August 1970 in Udomi-Uwessan community of Irrua. He attended Udomi Community Primary School and Ujabhole Community Secondary School, both in Uwesan Irrua, Esan Central LGA. He completed his secondary education and obtained his senior school certificate in Jos, Plateau State. Okpebholo contested for the Senate Seat in Edo Central senatorial district, under the All Progressives Congress (APC) and was elected on 25 February 2023. [24/09/2024, 13:57:47] Surge: *BENEFITS OF JOINING A YPG COMMITTEE*


1. It's an avenue for self expression and helps you to inspire significant impact in YPG through your unique personality, ideas, and skills. Join the committee that best utilizes your strength and skills and that will best ensure you make that impact you desire, and work with other Young Pharmacists in your team.

2. It inspires other Young Pharmacists and contributes to the growth of Young Pharmacists, and YPG.

3. It develops you leadership-wise. You will discover that the extent of the impact you can make is limitless.

4. It enhances teamwork and collaboration. You get to know your team members, work closely with them and collaborate with them to impact YPG through your committee. Infact, you can impact other members of your committee and inspire them towards personal and collective growth and development.

Today, we celebrate the incredible contributions of pharmacists around the world. 🌍 As the first point of contact for health advice and care, pharmacists play a crucial role in meeting global health needs by:

• Researching and developing new medicines. 🧪💉
• Ensuring the safety and efficacy of treatments through pharmacovigilance. 🛡️
• Promoting greener practices and addressing environmental impacts on health. 🌱
• Advocating for policies that drive better health outcomes. 📜💙

‎[25/09/2024, 07:29:29] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: *World Pharmacists Day Celebration*

As we mark the World Pharmacists Day today, themed: *"Pharmacists: Meeting Global Health Needs",* we acknowledge the significant contributions of pharmacists in healthcare space.

Pharmacists are integral to our health-care systems, often being the first point of contact for health advice and primary health care, as well as addressing the health needs of our populations in many varied ways, including:

💊Ensure access to and provide guidance on essential medicines and medical devices, including diagnostic tests and assistive products.
💊Provide expertise for patient care and public health.
💊Promote disease prevention, such as by administering vaccines, conducting health screening, educating patients, and helping to improve health literacy.
💊Support public health campaigns.
💊Participate in the research and development of new medicines.
💊Lead in pharmacovigilance, for instance, ensuring the safety and efficacy of antibiotics and other medicines.
💊Implement greener ways of work ‎image omitted

‎[26/09/2024, 08:53:34] ~ Dr. Favvy☺️: *IS MY BABY ALLERGIC TO COW'S MILK?😟*

Cow’s milk allergy is an atypical response of the immune system to milk and milk-containing products. It is among the most common food allergies that infants and young children have. 

Approximately 2.5% of children under 3 years old are allergic to milk and about 70% of children with cow milk allergy can tolerate baked cow milk. 

Avoiding milk and milk-containing products is the primary treatment for milk allergy. Most times, many children outgrow milk allergy. However, those who don't outgrow it may need to continue to avoid the use of milk-containing products.

How do you know a child is allergic to cow's milk?

And What can you do when you find out a child is allergic?🤔

*Click the link to know more...👇*
https://www.mypaediatricdoctor.com/2024/09/is-my-baby-allergic-to-cows-milk.html

[26/09/2024, 20:23:09] PharmahubNG Austine: Top 2% Scientists in the World as published on 16 September 2024 by Elsevier/Stanford University (USA): Extracted Data for Nigerian Scholars

The Stanford University/Elsevier top scientists list of the world's top quality scientists for 2024 is out. The list, made by Stanford University, USA, and Elsevier, shows the top 2% of scientists from all over the world; extract for scientists/scholars from any country can be made from the global list. 

The Stanford University/Elsevier list shows scientists that have had the biggest impact in the fields, which, amongst other criteria, looks at things like how often other scientists mention their works. It should be noted that the prestigious American University, Stanford, annually establishes the ranking of the most influential researchers in the world among more than 8 million researchers.

From the extracted Data for Nigerian Scholars, four scientists from the great University of Benin, Benin City, made this year's list. They are ( in the ranking order):

1. Prof. Igbinosa, Etinosa O., of the Department of Microbiology, Faculty of Life Sciences,

2. Prof. Okonofua, Friday, Center Leader, ACE Center of Excellence in Reproductive Health Innovation,

3. Prof. Okuonghae, Daniel, of the Department of Mathematics, Faculty of Physical Sciences, and

Sports Update⚽🏀🥊♟🏆🇳🇬
27.09.2024

> Sports Stories & throwbacks; AJ's defeat; the FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup; the NPFL; CAF Champions League; CAF Confederations Cup; European football leagues; UEFA Europa League (UEL); Africa; Nigeria..


(1–13)

1. 🇳🇬🎉 The GOAT of the NPFL adds a year today! Kano Pillars midfielder, Rabiu Ali, made his NPFL professional debut in 2006. He has 121 career goals and 36 assists, a record from 2015. He has over 150 goal contributions, have scored in 14 consecutive seasons, have won 4 NPFL titles and an FA Cup. He is a true icon of the game, record goal scorer, and assist king of the Nigeria Professional Football League. Happy 44th Birthday to Rabiu Ali!

2. 🏀🎙 When we talk Basketball, we usually mention Steph Curry, the star basketball player who is known for his 3-point shots. He was one of USA's stars during the Olympics few months back, and the star player of the Golden State Warriors, an NBA team.. Steph's dad was an NBA player himself, but he didn’t start off with much. When he was young, all he had to practice with was a rickety old basketball hoop that his grandfather had installed many years back. He learned to dribble over rocks, gravel, and potholes.. Steph: “Make it work no matter what you have to work with – that’s something that stuck with me very early on.“ As he grew older, he had other obstacles, including his size: “When it (came) to basketball, I was always the smallest kid on my team. I had a terrible, ugly, shot from the time I was 14 because I wasn’t strong enough to shoot over my head. You’d think there are no hurdles or obstacles that I had to overcome, but even when I got to high school I wasn’t ranked.. “If you take time to realize what your dream is and what you really want in life– no matter what it is, whether it’s sports or in other fields– you have to realize that there is always work to do, and you want to be the hardest working person in whatever you do, and you put yourself in a position to be successful. And you have to have a passion about what you do. Basketball was mine, and that’s what’s carried me to this point.”.. Steph Curry has been 4x NBA champion, 2x NBA's most valuable player, among others. He also gives back to the society through charity.

3. 🗣 Pep Guardiola (on how Sergio Busquets was discovered at Barça): “When I was coaching Barcelona, ​​I always said that there was something missing in the midfield. I needed a player who understood what I was thinking. One day, Tito Vilanova and I were watching the third team’s training, and suddenly Tito said to me, “Look at this bad defender!” He was referring to the player Busquets and Guardiola complimented Tito, saying that he is slow like a turtle and his structure is very weak, but I noticed that he was able to get out of pressure in a way that I had never seen before. I asked about the name of the defender and they told me Busquets and Tito said that our team is bad and we do not need a bad defender, but I insisted on promoting Busquets to Barcelona B and changed his position from center back to center and he said; the player is physically weak, how can he play with a focus? Guardiola said, “I don’t need a strong player. I need a player who knows how to get out of pressure.”❤.. Busquets partnered Iniesta and Xavi in the heart of FC Barcelona's midfield during Pep's and Messi's time. They formed the best midfield trio that you probably would ever ask for!

4. 🎙 Vincent Kompany (after Bayern's 5–0 win vs Bremen last Saturday) on Bremen having 0.00 xG today: "I'm humble enough as a coach to give credit to the players. I was in a position last season [at Burnley] where we played against teams with much better players, clubs much wealthier. If top players run and fight for each other then that's a big part of the job. There's of course an idea behind everything we do. But this [0.00 xG] was possible because the guy who scored two goals [Olise] was running for his teammates. It was because the guy who scored 11 or 12 goals this season [Kane] was running for the team. Coman, Gnabry, Sané, everyone was running for the team. We do it together. I'm realistic enough to give the credit to the players and they deserve it today."❤...

5. ⚽ The term xG in football is an abbreviation which stands for 'expected goals'. It is a statistical measurement of the quality of goalscoring chances and the likelihood of them being scored. Bremen having an xG of 0.00 simply means that they were analyzed to have a zero chance of scoring a goal in the game.. Bayern Munich have scored 20 goals in their last three games (6–1, 9–2, 5–0). Vincent Kompany is the first Bayern coach since Pep Guardiola in 2015/16 to win the first three away games in the Bundesliga, and also the first since Carlo Ancelotti in 2016/17 to win his first four Bundesliga games.

6. 🇳🇬 Last week, Nigeria's Chijioke Mbaoma, signed a 2-year deal with the Libyan club, Al Ittihad SC, days after he was announced as Heartland FC player. The 21-year old who was the NPFL's Golden Boot Winner last season (with Enyimba FC), temporarily signed for Heartland FC. In addition to being the NPFL's highest goal scorer in the 2023/24 season, he was the League Bloggers Awards Striker of the season and Best Player of the season winner. All the best to Chijioke!

7. 🥊 Last Saturday, Anthony Joshua (AJ) missed out on the chance to become a three-time heavyweight champion after he was defeated by Daniel Dubois, in the fifth round.. Dubois (27) knocked down AJ (34) towards the end of the opening round with an overhand right to AJ's chin. The IBF heavyweight champion then dropped AJ at the end of round three and twice in the fourth. A right hook ended the fight with a knockout for Dubois' first defence of the title. The fighters went toe to toe at London's Wembley Stadium in front of a record 96,000 fans.

8. ⚽ The FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup came to an end last Sunday. The third place game took place a day before, as USA defeated Netherlands 2–1 AET, to finish Bronze (3rd). North Korea won the final, defeating Japan 1–0 to lift the trophy! They now hold the joint record for the most successful side in the tournament's history (3) with Germany and USA. Choe Il-son (North Korea) won both the Golden Ball and the Golden Boot, as the Player of the Tournament and Top Goalscorer. Manaka Matsukubo (Japan) and Ally Sentnor (USA) won the Silver Ball and Bronze Ball, respectively. Vendito (Brazil) and Maya Hijikata (Japan) won the Silver Boot and Bronze Boot, respectively. Femke Liefting (Netherlands) received the Golden Glove.

9. ⚽ Last weekend in European league football was entertaining as always. In the EPL; Chelsea, Liverpool, Tottenham recorded wins. The big one between Man City vs Arsenal ended in a 2–2 draw. Man United, also played out a draw. In La Liga; Real Madrid and Barcelona recorded emphatic wins. In the Bundesliga; Bayern Munich, Stuttgart, Bayer Leverkusen, recorded wins. Dortmund unfortunately lost 5–1 to Stuttgart. Victor Boniface scored the winning goal for Leverkusen in their 4–3 victory vs Wolfsburg. In the Serie A; Fiorentina, Roma, AC Milan recorded wins. The big game between Juventus vs Napoli ended 0–0, while AC Milan defeated Inter Milan 2–1. In Ligue 1; Nice, AS Monaco, Marseille recorded wins. Nice defeated Saint-Étienne 8–0. PSG had a 1–1 draw vs Brest. We don't often mention the Eredivisie (Netherlands). It's a top ranked European league too, with teams such as PSV Eindhoven, Ajax, Feyenoord, among others. PSV currently tops the league after 6 games with 18 points (6W).

10. 🇳🇬⚽ The 2024/25 CAF Champions League (and Confederations Cup) kicked-off on August 16. It usually starts with 2 qualification rounds as over 50 teams from the top leagues of various African counties gets to be reduced to 16 teams who will then be drawn into 4 groups of 4 teams each for the CCL proper. Nigeria had two representatives among the 54 clubs – Remo Stars and Enugu Rangers. In the qualification round 1, Remo Stars lost to AS Far of Morocco (3–2 agg). Enugu Rangers progressed to the round 2, but was knocked out by Sagrada Esperança of Angola (3–2 agg). This implies that no Nigerian club will be involved in the CAF CL this season.. In the CAF Confederations Cup, 2 qualification rounds also took place, involving over 40 teams. El Kanemi Warriors and Enyimba FC were involved in the qualification rounds. Enyimba FC made it to the CAF CC group stage, and would be the only team from Nigeria representing at the African (CAF) level this season.

11. ⚽ The UEFA Europa League had their first games on Wednesday and Thursday. 36 clubs are involved (just as in the UCL). Man United and Tottenham are the English teams in this season's UEL. Man United played out a 1–1 draw with Twente, while Tottenham Hotspur recorded a 3–0 win vs Qarabag.

12. ⚽ Some league cup games took place in the midweek, such as the Coppa Italia and EFL (Carabao) Cup. Some european leagues also had midweek games like La Liga. Chelsea, Man City, Arsenal and Liverpool recorded wins in their EFL Cup fixtures and progressed to the fourth round. Chelsea's 5–0 win vs Barrow was a remarkable follow up from their 3–0 win vs West Ham last weekend in the EPL. It's safe to say that Enzo Maresca have turned things around at Chelsea and put smiles unto the faces of the fans. Arsenal and Liverpool also recorded heavy wins of 5–1 each.

13. ⚽ It's another weekend of Interesting fixtures across Nigeria, Africa and Europe. Some fixtures are: Niger Tornadoes vs Bendel Insurance, Rivers United vs Enyimba FC, Remo Stars vs Enugu Rangers, Bayern Munich vs Bayer Leverkusen, Man United vs Tottenham, Atlético Madrid vs Real Madrid.. The second round of games for the UCL league phase comes up next Tuesday and Wednesday. Two of the fixtures are: Arsenal vs PSG, Aston Villa vs Bayern.

*WORLD HEART DAY, 2024*
Sunday, 29.09.2024

Theme: *Use Heart for Action*


World Heart Day is a global campaign dedicated to raising awareness about cardiovascular health and the prevention of heart disease and stroke. It is an international observance aimed at educating people about the dangers of heart disease and stroke, as well as promoting healthy living habits that can prevent these conditions. The campaign encourages people to take charge of their heart health by adopting a balanced diet, engaging in regular physical activity, avoiding tobacco use, and managing stress. It also advocates for improved health policies and access to healthcare services to reduce the global burden of cardiovascular diseases.

Preventive Measures to Keep Heart Healthy:

• Keeping body mass index (BMI) under control, BMI Ranges - Underweight = <18.5, Normal weight = 18.5 – 24.9, Overweight = 25 – 29.9, Obesity = 30 or greater

• Keeping an eye on high blood pressure (hypertension) and high level of cholesterol (Hyperlipidemia), as well as blood glucose

• Limiting the consumption of excess sodium - risk of high blood pressure (hypertension)

• Understanding the early signs and symptoms and taking appropriate action to avoid any complications

• Avoiding sedentary lifestyle, opting for active lifestyle by indulging in physical activities

• Monitoring heart health through consultation and awareness programs

• Eating healthy and balanced diets, avoiding trans fat and junk foods

• Avoiding smoking and alcohol consumption

• Learning to manage the stress and getting quality sleep


_As Healthcare Professionals, we should advocate for a healthy heart and also ensure we have healthy hearts_ ‎image omitted

‎[03/10/2024, 07:05:45] Sir Hope Onyemaechi: *Fellow Young Pharmacists of Edo State,*

As we stand at the forefront of healthcare delivery in Nigeria, I invite you to join me on a journey to elevate our profession and amplify our impact. My ambition to become the *NATIONAL CHAIRMAN of the Pharmaceutical Society of Nigeria-Young Pharmacists Group (PSN-YPG)* is built on a foundation of passion, dedication, and a vision for a brighter future.

We are the backbone of our healthcare system, working tirelessly to ensure access to quality medicines and care. Yet, we face challenges that demand collective action and bold leadership. 

Born and raised in the ancient city of Benin, Edo State, I've had the privilege of receiving all my academic training here in Edo State both at:
- Primary level (Emotan Primary School, Benin City)

[04/10/2024, 17:04:12] Daniel Adulphus Ypgd: Pharm, whatever you do, please do not buy, dispense or accept insulin that is parallelly imported. The molecule is fragile enough, alterations in storage temperature could damage them. So, what are the odds that it survives the rigours of smuggling?
[04/10/2024, 17:04:12] Daniel Adulphus Ypgd: I can understand the economic situation in the country and how patients' demand for what is cheaper could push us into finding alternative sources that are more affordable.

But please, for essential medications, especially the ones needed for emergency situations like Insulins, kindly insist that you get only what is NAFDAC registered and properly preserved.

It's important because in such emergencies, these drugs must work or the patient dies or suffers a serious and possibly irreversible complication. This is what an emergency means.

I am writing this now because an Endocrinologist at a Teaching Hospital here in Lagos shared her experience with me and it wasn't pleasant.

The scenario was such that as the dose of insulin was being increased, glycemia was rising as well. Imagine the exasperation and confusion of everyone involved in the case management. Picture a scenario where the doctors are at a loss as to what else to do. That is the situation that fake, sub-standard, poorly stored, poorly transported, parallelly imported fragile molecules like insulin could cause.

So please, do more, check more. Confirm that it has a NAFDAC Number and that it comes from a place with a proper storage condition as recommended for cold chain medications.

[05/10/2024, 08:18:09] Surge: *WORLD MENINGITIS DAY*
Saturday, 05.10.2024


Meningitis is a serious and potentially life-threatening disease that affects people of all ages. It is caused by the inflammation of the tissues surrounding the brain and spinal cord, usually due to infection. Meningitis can be caused by various organisms, including bacteria, viruses, fungi and parasites of which bacterial meningitis is the most severe and deadly type and viral meningitis is the most common.

*Symptoms* are dependent on the cause, disease course (acute, subacute or chronic), brain involvement (meningo-encephalitis) and systemic complications (e.g sepsis).

Common symptoms include neck stiffness, fever, confusion or altered mental status, headaches, nausea and vomiting. Not so frequent symptoms include; seizures, coma and neurological deficits.

*Prevention*

Vaccines give the best protection against common types of bacterial meningitis.


*Myths about Meningitis⁉️*

People have different opinions concerning this disease and how it occurs ;

*Myth 1: Meningitis is contagious.*

*Reality*: Meningitis itself is not contagious, but the bacteria or viruses that cause it can spread through respiratory droplets, throat secretions, or close contact.

*Myth 2* ; *Only young children get meningitis.*

*Reality*: Meningitis affects people of all ages, with varying risk factors, young children, adolescents, and the elderly are more susceptible.

*Myth 3; Meningitis is spread through casual contact.*

Reality: Close contact, such as sharing foods/drinks or kissing, increases transmission risk.

Myth 4: *Meningitis is always fatal?*

Reality: Prompt treatment can significantly improve outcomes. Vaccination and early detection reduce mortality rates.

[05/10/2024, 13:47:37] Pharm Billy: *FG Bans Use Of Monotherapy Drugs For Malaria Treatment*

The National Malaria Elimination Program ( NMEP) of the federal ministry of health says that the use of mono therapy for malaria treatment remains prohibited in the country.

Program officer of NMEP, Wudi Natasha Tanko stated this Thursday during a media chart organized by the organization in Abuja.

She said monotherapy refers to the use of only one antimalarial medicine to treat malaria such as artesunate and artemeter injection, chloroquine and sulfadoxine/pyrimethamine (SP).

She said, ” monotherapies are not recommended for treatment of uncomplicated malaria and cannot cure. Chloroquine and SP are failed drugs with 39% and 56% efficacy respectively. Artesunate and artemeter injection have very short half live. They attack malaria parasite fast but do not sustain in the body to mop up residual parasites.
“Use of mono therapies for uncomplicated malaria is abuse.”

She said dangers of the use of mono therapies is incomplete cure, increased disease severity and development
of drug resistance.

She highlighted that Artemisinin-based combination therapies ( ACTs) are the recommended treatments for uncomplicated malaria. She added that ACTs are medicines consisting of an artemisinin derivative and another schizonticidal antimalarial medicine.

She also said malaria cannot be diagnosed based on clinical (signs and symptoms) assessment alone , adding that diagnosis requires testing confirmation of a clinical suspicion.

Wudi said, ” Case management intervention through prompt diagnosis and treatment with recommended antimalarial is pivotal for reduction of malaria burden.”

Nigeria accounts for 27% of global cases and 31% of deaths.

Progress has been made in the control of malaria burden as reflected in the National Malaria Indicator Survey (NMIS) reducing from 42% in 2010 to 22% in 2021.

[06/10/2024, 06:53:34] Surge: *World Cerebral Palsy Day, 2024*

*Theme: UniquelyCP*

Cerebral palsy, the most common childhood physical disability, is caused by damage to the brain before birth or in infancy. People living with cerebral palsy can have neurological and musculoskeletal problems that affect posture, sensory perceptions, communication, movement and other functions.

*What You Need to Know*

1. Injuries to the brain before, during or after birth can cause cerebral palsy.

2. Symptoms of cerebral palsy are usually first noticed in infants and toddlers.

3. Almost half the children affected by cerebral palsy develop hypertonia (excessive muscle tension) or spasticity (excessive muscle tension with increased tendon reflexes).

4. There is currently no cure for cerebral palsy, but treatment can address associated neurologic, orthopedic and medical conditions.

*Causes*

- Preterm birth
- Head injuries
- Brain/spinal cord infections
- Obstructed oxygen flow
- Blood flow blockage
- Malnutrition
- Heavy metal ingestion

*Symptoms*

- Motor delay
- Hypertonia (excessive muscle tension)
- Spasticity
- Uncontrolled movements
- Vision, hearing, and speech problems
- Learning disorders and behavior problems
- ⁠Other symptoms include,
Seizures
Vision, hearing and/or speech problems
Learning disorders and behavior problems
Intellectual or developmental disabilities
Respiratory problems
Gastrointestinal and nutrition issues
Bowel and bladder problems
Bone abnormalities, including scoliosis (a sideways curvature and rotation of the back bones) and hip dysplasia (dislocation)

*Types*

- Spastic diplegia (legs affected)-more likely to affect babies born preterm.
- Spastic quadriplegia (all limbs affected)-Full-term or preterm babies may have this type.
- Spastic hemiplegia (one side of the body affected)-may occur in children who have had one or more bleeding episodes in the brain’s ventricles. 

*Treatment*

There is no cure for CP, but there are many treatment options to help the problems associated with the condition. 

- Baclofen (muscle relaxant)
- Therapeutic electrical stimulation (TES)
- Selective Dorsal Rhizotomy (SDR) surgery
- Physical, occupational, and speech therapy

*Key Points*

- No cure exists, but treatment manages associated conditions.
- Early diagnosis and intervention improve outcomes.

‎[07/10/2024, 08:08:04] ~ Dr. Favvy☺️: *RECOGNIZING AND MANAGING CHILDHOOD ANXIETY*

For a long time, it was believed that children did not experience anxiety or depression and that those who seemed to were merely malingering or seeking attention. This is no longer the case. Recent research shows that as many as 8 to 11% of children and adolescents suffer from anxiety.

For many parents, it can be difficult to spot the signs of anxiety in a child as it can show up in different ways. You are unsure about when a child’s behaviour is something for you to worry about, or whether it is a fairly normal behaviour for children of that age.

It can be difficult to distinguish what a ‘normal’ amount of concern is, and when to seek further help...

So, what is anxiety, what signs does it presents in children and how can you help a child that is affected...

[07/10/2024, 10:53:54] Pharm Mike Graceville Pharmacy (dreamlife): NNPC steps down as middleman in Dangote Refinery petrol purchases — Report

The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) is ending its exclusive purchase agreement with Dangote Refinery, opening up the market for other marketers to buy petrol directly from the refinery, PREMIUM TIMES is reporting.

This means NNPC will no longer be the sole off-taker, and marketers can now negotiate prices directly with Dangote Refinery. This development aligns with the current practices for fully deregulated products, where refineries can sell directly to marketers on a willing buyer, willing seller basis.

Earlier in September, Devakumar Edwin, vice president at Dangote Industries Limited, said the 650,000 barrels per day Dangote Refinery has begun the processing of petrol. Mr Edwin explained that NNPC Limited would buy its product exclusively.

But the NNPC, in reaction to a statement that the Dangote Refinery Limited is being undermined by actions of the company at the time, said it was not the sole offtaker of all products from the Dangote Refinery. It said the refinery was free to sell its petrol to any marketer.

The NNPC explained that the Dangote Refinery and any other domestic refinery were free to sell directly to any marketer on a willing buyer, willing seller basis, which is the current practice for all fully deregulated products such as diesel, aviation fuel and kerosene. But on 15 September, the NNPC began loading petrol from the Dangote Refinery. Although some major petroleum marketers were later reportedly approved to lift the product from the refinery under an agreement with NNPC Ltd, independent marketers remained excluded. [Swipe]

[08/10/2024, 13:42:03] Mamabasii: Hiring!!!
Job Title 
Pharmacists

Locations 
Victoria Island & Apapa

Salary
220k

Industry 
Pharmacy 

Workplace Type 
On Site

Job description
Community pharmacists are well-respected professionals within their local community who use their expert knowledge of medicines to help patients get the best possible care and outcomes from their medicines.
As a community pharmacist, you'll be responsible for dispensing prescription and over-the-counter medicines that help people to maintain and improve their lives, in a cost-effective way. You will be responsible for constantly monitoring the quality, safety, and use of medicines, which requires a high level of interaction with patients, providing advice and information about the use of medicines and medical appliances.

As a community pharmacist, you will work alongside pharmacy technicians and pharmacy support staff, such as pharmacy assistants to deliver the pharmacy service. Each person is a high valued member of the pharmacy team. Your location of work will typically be a high street pharmacy, part of a chain or an independent, or you might work in a doctor's practice or health centre.

Key responsibilities

As a community pharmacist, you'll be responsible for:

Dispensing of prescription and over-the-counter medicines to the public
reviewing prescriptions from doctors to ensure accuracy and suitability for the patient, including the dosage, ingredients required, and correctly and safely labelled.

Supervise the preparation of any medicines when not supplied ready-made by manufacturers

Maintaining accurate pharmacy records, patient profiles, charge system files, and inventories
maintaining a register of controlled drugs for legal and stock control purposes

Liaising with doctors and other healthcare professionals to monitor, review and evaluate the effectiveness of medications

Advising the public on medicines, side-effects of medicines and the treatment of minor ailments

Providing advice on specialist health care issues, such as vaccinations, blood pressure, smoking cessation, cholesterol monitoring and diabetes

Screening
managing, supervising, educating and training pharmacy support staff

management of pharmacy finances and medicines budgets
ordering and purchasing pharmaceutical supplies, medical supplies, or drugs

maintaining stock and storing and handling it correctly

Working Schedule 
Mondays morning shift 8am - 4pm & afternoon 2pm - 9pm

 from Tuesday to Friday. alternate days 8am - 9pm aternate weekends 8-5pm

Interested candidates should send CV to WhatsApp 0901 223 0766

‎[10/10/2024, 10:07:42] Surge: WORLD MENTAL HEALTH DAY 2024
Thursday, 10.10.2024

Theme: "It is Time to Prioritize Mental Health in the Workplace".


This year's focus highlights the importance of addressing mental health issues in our professional lives, recognizing that a healthy work environment is crucial for our overall well-being.

Mental health, according to the World Health Organization (WHO), is a state of well-being that enables individuals to realize their abilities, cope with life's stresses, work productively, and contribute to their community. 
It's not just the absence of mental disorders, but a complex continuum that varies from person to person, with different levels of difficulty and distress.

Key aspects of mental health:

•⁠  ⁠Realizing one's abilities: being able to reach your full potential.
•⁠  ⁠Coping with life's stresses: managing daily challenges and setbacks.
•⁠  ⁠Working productively: contributing to society through work or other activities.
•⁠  ⁠Contributing to the community: participating in social and civic life.

Determinants of Mental Health

Risk Factors

1. Individual: emotional skills, substance use, genetics.
2. Social: poverty, violence, inequality, environmental deprivation.
3. Developmental: harsh parenting, bullying.

Protective Factors

1. Individual: social-emotional skills, positive relationships.
2. Community: quality education, decent work, safe neighborhoods.

Mental Health Care and Treatment

1. Community-based care is vital for accessibility and recovery.
2. Integrated services: general healthcare, community centers, psychosocial rehabilitation.
3. Innovative approaches: non-specialist counseling, digital self-help.

Action Areas

1. Strengthen mental health services.
2. Address social determinants.
3. Promote community-based care.
4. Develop innovative solutions. ‎image omitted

[12/10/2024, 13:29:30] Dr Maurice GSK: A Coca-Cola employee offered to sell company secrets to Pepsi for 1.5 million dollars. Pepsi responded by notifying Coca-Cola.

As high-ranking Coca-Cola employees, Joya Williams and her accomplice Ibrahim Dimson had access to many documents about Coca-Cola drinks and future projects. Williams and Dimson so called Pepsi and offered to sell all the executive secrets for $1.5 million.

Unfortunately for Williams and Dimson, Pepsi executives reported them to Coca-Cola and the FBI. The FBI then sent undercover agents posing as Pepsi executives. Those FBI undercover agents lured Williams and Dimson with a portion of the $1.5 million demanded and forced them to hand over the documents and the vial containing the chemical. Williams and Dimson were caught red-handed.

The FBI presented the proof of payment and the secrets to the court as irrefutable evidence. In 2007, Williams was sentenced to eight years in prison and Dimson to five years in prison.

A Pepsi spokesperson said, "We did what any responsible company would do. Competition can be fierce, but it also has to be fair and legal," according to CNN.

Eight years in prison is the sentence given to Joya Williams, the former Coca-Cola employee and five years to his accomplice, Ibrahim Dimson, who had attempted to sell the secret formula of the famous drink to competitor Pepsi without taking into account that, in addition to patents, the law also protects business secrets.

[12/10/2024, 16:10:52] Surge: *WORLD ARTHRITIS DAY 2024* 
Saturday, 12.10.2024

*Theme: Informed Choices, Better Outcomes*


The theme focuses on empowering people with rheumatic and musculoskeletal diseases (RMDs) to make informed decisions about their health.

Arthritis is not one disease, but a term for many conditions that affect the joints of your body. Joints are points where 2 or more bones meet, such as in the wrist, knuckles, hips, knees and ankles.

Arthritis damages your joints, usually resulting in discomfort and pain. It can range from mild to severe and can affect people of all ages.


The most common types of arthritis are:

    - Osteoarthritis
    - Rheumatoid arthritis
    - Gout
    - Ankylosing spondylitis
    - Juvenile arthritis (affecting children)

*Symptoms:*

The symptoms of arthritis vary from person to person. Some joint symptoms, such as:

    - Pain
    - Swelling
    - Redness and warmth
    - Stiffness
    - Reduced movement

*Causes and risk factors:*

    - Genetic factors
    - Immune system issues
    - Metabolic conditions (e.g., gout)
    - Age
    - Family history
    - Obesity
    - Smoking
    - Repetitive joint movements
    - Previous joint damage

*Diagnosis:*
    - Physical examination
    - Medical history
    - Blood tests
    - Joint fluid sampling
    - Imaging tests (X-ray, ultrasound, CT scan)
    - Referral to a rheumatologist

*Treatment:*
    - Medications (pain relief, anti-inflammatory, DMARDs)
    - Surgery (joint replacement/repair)
    - Multidisciplinary care from:
        - Physiotherapist
        - Occupational therapist
        - Exercise physiologist
        - Podiatrist

_Welfare Update_ 
15/10/2024

*PANS UNIBEN APPRECIATES HEALTHRITE PHARMACY*

Following the discussion of the PANS Uniben Presidency with the CEO of Healthrite Pharmacy, we are pleased to announce the emergence of two of our 400 level students (Okungbowa Benjamin and Akpochimara Blessing) as recipients of the Scholarship scheme set up by the CEO/MD of Healthrite, Dr  Ekene Uwaogu. 

We appreciate Dr Ekene for this huge philanthropism. 

This scholarship is valid until their graduation from the faculty of Pharmacy. 
We also appreciate the Dean for his acknowledgement which was necessary to facilitate the process. 

The President PANS UNIBEN Congratulates the scholarship recipients and wishes them academic excellence.

Let me at this juncture plead with all the parties involved to observe some restraints because PSN is more important than all of us.

Sports Update⚽🏀🥊♟️🏆🇳🇬
18.10.2024

> Sports Stories & throwbacks; the October International break; the U-17 Women's World Cup; European football; Africa; Nigeria..


(1–13)

1. 🇳🇬 Meet Hon. Kunle Soname, a Nigerian Businessman from Ikenne Remo, Ogun State who owns three (3) football clubs In Nigeria and one (1) football club in Portugal. Hon. Kunle Soname is the ONLY surviving football CEO in Nigeria over the past few years having three clubs in the country (Remo Stars SC, Remo Stars Ladies and Beyond Limits FA). He owns Portuguese club, CD Feirense. He owns Nigerian sports betting company, Bet9ja. He's also the owner of the Private airline, ValueJet Airline. After the conclusion of 2023/24 football season, Nine (9) of his academy (Beyond Limits FA) players signed deals abroad...

2. 🇳🇬 ... The Sky Blue Stars stadium has a state-of-the-art facilities. Some of the facilities at the stadium include; a hotel, housing facilities for a football academy, a big restaurant, the main turf where matches are played, three (3) standard training pitches for matches and one (1) standard main pitch. Well equipped dressing rooms for home and away teams, conference room, lecture rooms, reception, etcetera. Other facilities include a clinic, a gym, tennis and basketball courts with several hostels where the young academy players stay. The Remo Stars stadium is CAF approved to host international matches in 2022.

3. ✨ In April of 1902, a side called Newton Heath FC were on the verge of bankruptcy after their president took the club to court over £240 which he was owed, the club was already in debt. The future of the club looked in major doubt, until the club captain was able to find 4 local business men who invested £2,000 in the club. The main investor, John Davies, became the new club president and made a few changes - their colours went from green/gold to red/white and the name was changed to *Manchester United Football Club*!

4. 🇳🇬 Sad news😞. The Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) has condoled with the families of the three media persons killed in a kidnapping ambush in Anambra. The victims were part of a SuperSport crew traveling to Uyo, Akwa Ibom to broadcast the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifying match between Nigeria and Libya — a game the Super Eagles won on October 11. They were said to have been ambushed along Ihiala-Orlu Road on Tuesday while traveling from Lagos to Uyo. The suspected bandits were said to have opened fire on the bus carrying the crew members and security personnel, resulting in the deaths of a cameraman, a police officer, and the bus driver. It was gathered that of the 14 persons in the vehicle at the time of the ambush, eight were rescued, two escaped, three were killed and one unaccounted for.

5. 🇳🇬 Nigerian Bodybuilder, Samson Dauda won the 2024 Mr Olympia Contest. He will receive a $600,000 cash prize, the highest payout ever for a winner of the contest.

6. 🇳🇬 Nigeria defeated Libya 1–0 at the Uyo stadium last Friday, with the return leg to have held on Tuesday. However, due to poor hospitality shown to the Super Eagles players, in which they were abandoned at a Libyan Airport for over 13 hours, the team decided not to go ahead with the game, and rather returned back to Nigeria... Later within the week, Rwanda defeated Benin (both in Group D) 2–1, a defeat that ensured that Nigeria still maintains their top position in Group D of the AFCON Qualifiers, with 1 less game played. With this, Nigeria needs at least 4 points from their remaining 3 games to qualify for AFCON 2025.. The Qualified teams for #AFCON2025 so far are: Morocco, DR Congo, Senegal, Uganda, Algeria, Angola, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, and Egypt.

7. 🇳🇬 The 2024 U-17 Women's World Cup kicked off on Wednesday, October 16 with the finals to be played on November 3. The Flamingos of Nigeria, who are in Group A with Ecuador, Dominican Republic and New Zealand, kicked off on a great note with a 4–1 win vs New Zealand. The goal scorers were: Taiwo Afolabi, Shakirat Moshood, Faridat Abdulwahab, and Taiwo Adegoke. Nigeria's next game is against Ecuador tomorrow (9 PM). The last game of the Group stage is against Dominican Republic next week Wednesday by 12 AM.

8. 🇳🇬 CAF has announced the Final Shortlist For Men’s Player Of The Year Award. The list includes: Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) and Brahim Diaz (Morocco & Real Madrid).

9. 👏🏻 During the International window, Argentina defeated Bolivia 6–0, with Lionel Messi directly involved in 5 of the goals (3G, 2A). It was a star performance from LM10, who have now scored 10 International hat-tricks (same as CR7). Leo Messi stats in 2024 is beautiful. 30 games, 25G, 16A (41 G/A in 30 games). He is averaging goal or assist every 59 minutes.

10. 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Thomas Tuchel has been appointed as England men's Head Coach. He will be assisted by Anthony Barry. The pair will begin work on 1st January 2025. Tuchel was Bayern Munich's former Coach, and had coached Chelsea FC before Bayern, where he won the UEFA Champions League with Chelsea in 2021.

11. ⚽ (a) Manchester United currently have the worst ever start to an EPL season after 7 games (8 points). Two of these have come in Erik Ten Hag's era. (b) Real Madrid are currently 2 games away from breaking the La Liga all time unbeaten run record. They are 41 games unbeaten, however, it will be down to Barcelona to end all hopes of Real Madrid breaking the record come October 26, when they face off in the El Clasico. (c) About 2 weeks ago, Real Madrid's captain, Dani Carvajal got injured in Madrid's game, breaking his knee and confirmed to miss the rest of the 2024/25 season. The next day, Real Madrid did something amazing and supportive, by extending his contract till June 2026! Carvajal's contract was to end this season.

12. ⚽ France Football, the organizers of the prestigious Ballon d’Or awards, are introducing a change in their protocol for the winner this year. The 2024 Ballon d’Or winner will only find out when the envelope is opened live during the ceremony as against knowing before the ceremony. The 2024 Ballon d'Or awards/ceremony takes place on October 28.. Real Madrid star, Vinicius Junior, is heavily tipped to win, with many considering him the frontrunner after his stellar performances last season, helping Los Blancos secure both LaLiga and UCL titles. He faces competition from Kylian Mbappe, Jude Bellingham, and Manchester City’s Rodri.

13. ⚽ If you're a Chelsea FC fan, you must be getting ready for the next couple of weeks. Chelsea's next couple games are big teams, with the next four EPL games against Liverpool, Newcastle, Manchester United and Arsenal.


Share your thoughts and opinions on the Sports Update. Hope you had a good week? Sports is beautiful. Do enjoy your weekend. ‎image omitted

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are need at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

Online training starts 4th November 2024.

‎[19/10/2024, 12:29:00] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: Are you tired of…

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.
* Expert-Led: Benefit from experienced facilitators who understand the pharmacy industry and its unique demands.
* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

* Start Date: November 2024
* Course Duration: 4 weeks (twice a week)
* Mode: Online (7 sessions) & Onsite (1 session)
* 	Course Fee: N10,000

https://lclcentre.org/trainings/coaching/emotional-intelligence-team-management/
