‎[20/10/2024, 14:28:08] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: Are you tired of…

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.

Mental health cases, especially those bothering on Substance Use Disorders, keep increasing with rising socio-economic woes bedeviling humanity especially in Low and Medium Income Countries.

 Unfortunately, gaps in combating this menace also keep increasingly on account of the shortfall of mental healthcare professionals across the globe.

There is a TSTS policy in place to help bridge this gap. It encourages other workers outside the field of psychiatry to be a part of the solution. 

The United Nations Office on Crimes and Drugs UNODC has developed and since deployed a Universal Treatment Curriculum for training interested personnel on prevention and treatment strategies when it comes to Substance Use Disorders.

The curriculum will once again come up live in Uyo to train Body of Pharmacists.

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are needed at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

Online training starts 11th November 2024.

‎[21/10/2024, 11:51:30] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: Are you tired of…

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.
* Expert-Led: Benefit from experienced facilitators who understand the pharmacy industry and its unique demands.
* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

* Start Date: November 2024
* Course Duration: 4 weeks (twice a week)
* Mode: Online (7 sessions) & Onsite (1 session)
* 	Course Fee: N10,000

[24/10/2024, 10:27:33] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE AND TEAM MANAGEMENT TRAINING - A TIMELY CAPSULE FOR EVERY PHARMACIST.

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are needed at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

Online training starts 11th November 2024.

Register Now.

Thank you.

Dr. Allen IBOI,

‎[24/10/2024, 10:27:35] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: Are you tired of…

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.
* Expert-Led: Benefit from experienced facilitators who understand the pharmacy industry and its unique demands.
* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

* Start Date: November 2024
* Course Duration: 4 weeks (twice a week)
* Mode: Online (7 sessions) & Onsite (1 session)
* 	Course Fee: N10,000

To register click the link below NOW

https://lclcentre.org/trainings/coaching/emotional-intelligence-team-management/

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are needed at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?

* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

*Sports Update*⚽🏀🥊♟️🏆🇳🇬
25.10.2024

> Sports Stories & throwbacks; the MLS (USA); NBA basketball; the U-17 Women's World Cup; European football; Africa; Nigeria..


(1–8)

1. 👋🏻 It's Edo YPG Sports Update once again. Let's start with some significant dates in Sports: *El Clasico* (Real Madrid vs Barcelona): Tomorrow Saturday, October 26 by 8pm... *Ballon d'Or awards and ceremony*: Monday, October 28, in France... *CAF Awards*: December 16, in Marrakech, Morocco.

2. 🗣️ *Carlo Ancelotti* (Real Madrid's Coach): “Vinicius will win the Ballon d’Or, there can’t be anyone else winning it.”... "Barcelona have changed their philosophy, they played more vertically, in an easier way. But I don't want to compare with Xavi's Barcelona because we lost some times against him. We respect both versions of Barcelona."... “I have something planned for tomorrow, you’ll see it and then you can tell me if I was wrong or not.”... "Favourite tomorrow? I don't know, difficult to say. There is no favourite in such a game, derby and Clásico... it depends on how the teams play."

3. 🏀 Are you a basketball lover? The *2024/25 NBA season* resumed this week. It will run till June 22, next year. You can follow up with your favourite basketballers and basketball teams. Basketball is a wonderful Sports❤️

4. 🇳🇬 In the *CAF Awards*, 10 African Players have been nominated for the Men's Player of the Year award, that will be given on December 16. Nigeria's captain and the AFCON Player of the tournament, *William Troost-Ekong* and *Ademola Lookman* were nominated. Ademola Lookman is the most likely winner of this year's award, an award which another Nigerian (Victor Osimhen) is the current holder. Victor Osimhen did not make the 10 player shortlist for the award this year.

5. 🏆 *Inter Miami* are the 2024 MLS Champions! It was a beautiful way to end the MLS season, last Sunday, as Inter Miami defeated New England Revolution 6–2, from a 2–0 losing position. *Lionel Messi* started on the bench, and was subbed on at the 57 mins (while it was 2–2). He was involved in the remaining 4 goals of the game, scoring a hattrick! *Luis Suarez* has been a star performer for Inter Miami as well. He had a brace of goals and assists. Lionel Messi (played 19 games) and Luiz Suarez (played 27 games) both finished on *20 goals each* for Inter Miami, with LM10 having 10 assists, while Suarez finished with 9 assists. Jordi Alba finished with 11 assists. Inter Miami finished with *74* points from 34 league games. The runner up, Columbus, finished with 66 points, while Los Angeles and LA Galaxy finished with 64 points each. 👏🏻 Inter Miami!

6. ✨ The third games of the 8-games league phase of the *UCL* took place on Tuesday and Wednesday. It was interesting as always. Bayern Munich lost to *Barcelona* (4–1) with the Brazilian star, Raphinha scoring a hattrick. The loss implies that Bayern have only won their first game vs Dinamo Zagreb (9–2), but unfortunately sit 23rd on the league phase table, with Zagreb above them on 22nd. It's crazy to think about. *Real Madrid* defeated Dortmund (5–2) with the Brazilian star and potential Ballon d'Or winner, *Vinicius Jnr*, scoring a hattrick. The top 2 Spanish teams feasted against the German teams, setting the perfect stage for tomorrow's *El Clasico* encounter. EPL teams top the UCL table currently! *Aston Villa*, *Liverpool*, and *Man City*.

7. 🇳🇬 In the ongoing U-17 Women's World Cup, *Nigeria* will play USA tomorrow by 8.30 pm. The Flamingos of Nigeria had a 100% record in the Group stage, with a 4–1 win vs New Zealand, 4–0 win vs Ecuador, and 1–0 win vs Dominican Republic. They now have to win their subsequent encounters to get to the final and win the tournament.

8. ⚽ Another interesting *EPL* weekend is here! Some of the games are: Man City vs Southampton, West Ham vs Man United, Chelsea vs Newcastle, Crystal Palace vs Tottenham, and *Arsenal vs Liverpool*!

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

‎[28/10/2024, 10:47:20] Daniel Adulphus Ypgd: *FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS ABOUT ABM REGISTRATION*

*Is ABM registration same as registration for the conference?*

No! Registration for ABM is different.

*How much is ABM registration?*

ABM registration is free and can be done in 2mins. It is just by filling the form through uploading basic information and documents.

*Is ABM Registration really that important?*

Yes it is. It is ONLY YPs that have Registered for ABM that can participate in the ABM activities such as elections.

*What if I don't register for ABM After the Stated Deadline, can I still vote for my candidate of choice during the ABM?*

 No! You cannot participate in the electoral process as only YPs who registered for ABM will vote.

*I am not sure of attending the conference now but what if I then make up my mind later to attend, can I still register for ABM?*

No! To be on a safe side, just register now.

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

[29/10/2024, 13:24:33] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE AND TEAM MANAGEMENT TRAINING - A TIMELY CAPSULE FOR EVERY PHARMACIST.

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are needed at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

Online training starts 11th November 2024.

Register Now.

Kindly pay #10,000 into the account details: 0064645981 Sterling Bank, Nwachukwu Idemili and for the evidence of payment to Pharm Abu Dantani John 09032625150 (WhatsApp).

Thank you.

Signed:

Dr. Allen IBOI,
Chairman ACPN 
Edo State
‎[29/10/2024, 13:24:34] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: Are you tired of…

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.
* Expert-Led: Benefit from experienced facilitators who understand the pharmacy industry and its unique demands.
* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

* Start Date: November 2024
* Course Duration: 4 weeks (twice a week)
* Mode: Online (7 sessions) & Onsite (1 session)
* 	Course Fee: N10,000

‎[31/10/2024, 13:34:38] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: Are you tired of…

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.

*Sports Update*⚽🇳🇬
01.11.2024


😅 Football lovers, it's been a crazy week! Let's highlight some key football events from last weekend..

1. 🎙️ *Barcelona's Pau Cubarsí on the offside trap*: "Tactically we work a lot on it, but above all it is a question of communication between the four players of the defense. When a player comes out, the others accompany to have a straight line."... “Who communicates the most between Iñigo and me? Well, it depends on where the action is, if it's on the right side with my full-back or the one on the left. Sometimes it's true that you can say that a good ball in the back can hurt you, but in the end we trusted the line, trusted our teammates and if everyone goes in the same direction, the opponent is offside. That requires a lot of concentration, communication and coordination."❤️

2. On Saturday (October 26): In the much anticipated El Clasico fixture in La Liga, *FC Barcelona defeated Real Madrid (4–0)* at Real Madrid's home stadium! It was 0–0 at HT, but Madrid fell after conceding the first goal in the second half.

3. On Monday (October 28): *Ballon d'Or* shocked the World, and Man City's *Rodri* was announced the 2024 Ballon d'Or Winner! Real Madrid's Vini Jnr came second. Madrid didn't show up to the ceremony after getting a hint that Vini Jnr won't be the winner.

4. On Tuesday: *Al-Nassr* lost 1–0 to Al-Taawoun in the R16 of the King's Cup. *CR7* made the highlight, as he missed a last minute penalty that would have sent the game to some additional time, and give Al-Nassr a chance to still qualify. Since CR7 joined Al-Nassr, he has lost more trophies than he has won. Today (Friday), Al-Nassr plays Neymar Jnr's *Al-Hilal*, the biggest team in the Saudi League, and a fixture that Al-Hilal has won so many times.

5. On Tuesday: The NFF confirmed the dates and venues for the country’s senior men’s national team final two Group D games for the 2025 AFCON qualification series against Rwanda and Benin. According to NFF, the CAF has scheduled *November 14 and 18* for the two games. The Super Eagles *currently top their Group D with 10 points* from four games, four points ahead of second-placed Benin Republic, while Rwanda has five points. Bottom-placed Libya has only one point and is out of the running for qualification. A win or draw against the Cheetahs of Benin Republic in Abidjan will secure the Super Eagles a ticket to the finals in Morocco, scheduled for December 2025/January 2026 with a game to spare.

6. On Wednesday: The fourth round fixtures of the *EFL (Carabao) Cup* took place, with surprising exits for Manchester City (who lost to Tottenham 2–1) and Chelsea (who lost to Newcastle United 2–0, few days after defeating same Newcastle in the EPL). The fixtures for the Quarter finals are: Tottenham vs Man United, Arsenal vs Crystal Palace, Southampton vs Liverpool, and Newcastle vs Brentford.

7. The Nigeria Professional Football League (NPFL) has also been ongoing. The fixtures this weekend will be the Game Week 10. After GW9, *Rivers United* are top of the league (21 pts). Remo Stars (18 pts), Enyimba FC (17 pts), Plateau United (14 pts), and Abia Warriors (14 pts) competes the top 5. *Bendel Insurance* of Edo State is 15th on the NPFL table, with 9 points and close to the relegation zone. They need to step up performance to avoid finishing poorly by the end of the 2024/25 season.

8. *League football* continues this weekend. In the EPL, we have interesting games such as: Newcastle vs Arsenal, Bournemouth vs Manchester City, Liverpool vs Brighton, Tottenham vs Aston Villa, and Manchester United vs Chelsea.


_Share your thoughts and opinions on the Sports Update. Hope you had a good week? Sports is beautiful. Do enjoy your weekend._

[01/11/2024, 09:15:50] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE AND TEAM MANAGEMENT TRAINING - A TIMELY CAPSULE FOR EVERY PHARMACIST.

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are needed at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

Online training starts 11th November 2024.

Register Now.

Thank you.

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are needed at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

‎[03/11/2024, 08:01:43] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: Are you tired of…

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.
* Expert-Led: Benefit from experienced facilitators who understand the pharmacy industry and its unique demands.
* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

[04/11/2024, 11:06:35] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE AND TEAM MANAGEMENT TRAINING - A TIMELY CAPSULE FOR EVERY PHARMACIST.

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are needed at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

Online training starts 11th November 2024.

Register Now.

Kindly pay #10,000 into the account details: 0064645981 Sterling Bank, Nwachukwu Idemili and for the evidence of payment to Pharm Abu Dantani John 09032625150 (WhatsApp).

Thank you.

Signed:

Dr. Allen IBOI,

‎[04/11/2024, 11:06:36] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: Are you tired of…

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.
* Expert-Led: Benefit from experienced facilitators who understand the pharmacy industry and its unique demands.
* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

* Start Date: November 2024
* Course Duration: 4 weeks (twice a week)
* Mode: Online (7 sessions) & Onsite (1 session)
* 	Course Fee: N10,000

To register click the link below NOW

https://lclcentre.org/trainings/coaching/emotional-intelligence-team-management/

Don’t miss this opportunity to redefine your career, improve your leadership skills, and transform your pharmacy practice with emotional intelligence! Register now and take the next step in becoming a more effective, empathetic, and successful pharmacist.

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.

* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

[07/11/2024, 09:45:02] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE AND TEAM MANAGEMENT TRAINING - A TIMELY CAPSULE FOR EVERY PHARMACIST.

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.
* Expert-Led: Benefit from experienced facilitators who understand the pharmacy industry and its unique demands.
* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

* Start Date: November 2024
* Course Duration: 4 weeks (twice a week)
* Mode: Online (7 sessions) & Onsite (1 session)

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are needed at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

Online training starts 11th November 2024.

‎[09/11/2024, 07:18:59] Sir Prof  Pharm Abu Dantani John: Are you tired of…

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.
* Expert-Led: Benefit from experienced facilitators who understand the pharmacy industry and its unique demands.
* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

* Start Date: November 2024
* Course Duration: 4 weeks (twice a week)
* Mode: Online (7 sessions) & Onsite (1 session)
* 	Course Fee: N10,000

Dear Colleagues,

I am greatly delighted to announce the first edition of the *Emotional intelligence and Team management* Training and Certification, Powered by the EDO ACPN.

This training is timely and essential for every Pharmacist especially community Pharmacists for the following reasons:
* Every practicing pharmacist relate with people (patients or clients, superiors and subordinates, contemporaries and colleagues, other healthcare practitioners etc) within their practice space and therefore need to understand how to manage emotions in dealing with other people.
* A pharmacist in any employment is a senior staff who is required provide leadership in their workplace. Hence, emotional intelligence - a critical management skill is imperative.
* Tough times are here with us in Nigeria and the days ahead may likely get tougher. People are Hungry, Cranky, On the Edge, Depressed, Confused, and barely surviving. Whereas business fortunes are dwindling for employers,  employee's take home cannot take them home. Therefore, Emotional Intelligence and Team Management Skills are needed at this time more than ever.

I therefore encourage all pharmacists especially community Pharmacists to register for this training, acquire the skill, get certified and become better in your practice.

Online training starts 11th November 2024.

* Dealing with difficult patients/ clients and team conflicts that drain your energy?
* Feeling overwhelmed by stress and emotional burnout in your pharmacy practice?
* Struggling to create a motivated and collaborative team in your pharmacy?

If you answered YES to any of these questions, then our 4-Week Course on Emotional Intelligence and Team Management for Community Pharmacists is exactly what you need!

Course Objectives:

This course is designed to empower Pharmacists especially community pharmacists with the emotional intelligence (EI) and team management skills they need to improve workplace dynamics, deliver exceptional patient care, and lead with confidence.

By the end of the course, you will:

* Understand the core components of emotional intelligence and how to apply them in patient care and team interactions.
* Master stress management techniques to maintain emotional control and prevent burnout.
* Develop empathy and active listening skills to enhance patient relationships and build stronger loyalty.
* Learn practical leadership strategies that foster collaboration, trust, and conflict resolution in your pharmacy team.
* Improve communication skills, making patient interactions smoother and more effective.

What You Will Learn:

Week 1: Introduction to Emotional Intelligence and Developing Self-Awareness

Week 2: Emotional Regulation, Empathy, and Handling Pressure

Week 3: Leadership Skills for Managing Teams with Emotional Intelligence

Week 4: Building Collaboration, Resilience, and Enhancing Workplace Well-being

Why Register for This Course?

* Tailored for Nigerian Pharmacists: Real-world examples and case studies relevant to the challenges you face daily.
* Empirical Data and Proven Techniques: Learn from the latest research on emotional intelligence and team management in healthcare.
* Expert-Led: Benefit from experienced facilitators who understand the pharmacy industry and its unique demands.
* Flexible Learning Mode: Online classes with one interactive onsite session to apply your skills in real-time.
* Affordable: Invest in your professional development for just N10,000—a small price for a big career transformation!

Course Details:

* Start Date: November 2024

[13/11/2024, 10:19:45] Dr Maurice GSK: News Release 

Benin City- 13/11/2024

Gov Okpebholo suspends revenue collection, orders Police Commissioner to arrest defaulters

Edo State Governor, Senator Monday Okpebholo, has ordered for the immediate and indefinite suspension of collection of all revenues in Edo, especially in motor parks and others, until further notice 

Governor Okpebholo has also ordered the State Commissioner of Police to arrest anyone who flouts the order. 

The Governor said he will review the issues surrounding the collections soon and decide on the way forward. 

“The collection of revenues in the State has been suspended indefinitely. Anyone seen collecting revenues on behalf of the State Government will be arrested. 

“The Commissioner of Police is hereby ordered to arrest anyone who flouts the order and collects any kind of revenues on behalf of the State Government. 

“The Governor will soon  address the issues and concerns raised. He will issue new directives soon. Until then, no one is authorised to collect revenues on behalf of the State Government.”

Signed:
Hon. Fred Itua, 
Chief Press Secretary to Edo State Governor

*_________________________________________*

The leadership of the Pharmaceutical Society of Nigeria - Young Pharmacists Group (PSN-YPG) is thrilled to announce and congratulate three of its exceptional members - Pharm. Adeabgo Ahmed, Pharm. Adedeji Oluwakorede, and Pharm. Lawal Saidat - on reaching the final stages of the prestigious Rhodes Scholarships West Africa grant.

Out of over 3000 applicants, 15 finalists were shortlisted after several rounds of screening and these young pharmacists were found worthy to be among the successful candidates for the award.

Of the three finalists, Korede and Adeabgo went on to bag a fully funded, three year scholarship to study any course of their choice in the University of Oxford, UK.

They are now the new Rhodes Scholars-elect who will be joining the Rhodes class of 2025.

This remarkable feat is a testament to their academic excellence, leadership potential, and commitment to creating positive change. 

The Rhodes Trust, an esteemed educational charity, identifies and nurtures outstanding individuals who dare to challenge the status quo and drive meaningful impact.

As finalists and winners, these talented young pharmacists have demonstrated the courage and determination required to excel in their chosen fields. 

The Rhodes Scholarship, a fully-funded postgraduate award, offers a unique opportunity to study at the University of Oxford, United Kingdom, and join a global community of visionary leaders.

PSN-YPG is immensely proud of its members' achievements and encourages all young pharmacists to strive for excellence, innovation, and service to humanity. 

We celebrate Pharm. Adeabgo, Pharm. Adedeni, and Pharm. Lawal's success and wish them the very best in their future endeavors.

[14/11/2024, 10:18:04] Pharm Osakponmwen Oviasogie: News Release 

Benin City - 14/11/2024

Gov Okpebholo reveals how he won Edo elections

Edo State Governor, Senator Monday Okpebholo, on Wednesday night in Benin, revealed how he won the 21st September governorship election in Edo State. 

He attributed it to the grace of God, constant prayers, and the support of Edo people. 

Governor Okpebholo gave the testimony at his post swearing-in Thanksgiving Service held at the Samuel Ogbumudia Stadium in Benin City, Edo State capital, where he urged Nigerians to trust in God alone irrespective of their challenges in life.

Governor Okpebholo also gave a vivid account on how he found a dead bat on his bed before he was declared the winner of the 21st September Edo State governorship election by the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC). 

He remarked: “I want to thank God. In this last election, while I was praising God, they (traducers) were busy operating from television. They were busy operating from social media. They were busy operating from other television stations.

“But, I took the battle to God because I knew the secret. A few days to the election, they said I was crazy. We gathered to praise God in this State. They said, "What is he doing?" They were there on TV. But, I was listening to the voice of God. I won the battle.

“After the election on Sunday morning, I came to my room. I met a bat had died on my bed, without me shooting any arrow. But, the spirit of God was there. The arrow of God; The hand of God delivered me.
“I am grateful to the men of God that stood in the gap. I am grateful to those who believed that with God, all things are possible. And I will give you one advice- trust in God alone because he will do it for you.

The Governor disclosed that he did not consult any native doctor or prophet or visit any diviner or shrine to seek help for help throughout the period of his electioneering.

The Thanksgiving worship service had in attendance prominent politicians, music artists, and clergymen.

Signed:
Mr. Fred Itua, 
Chief Press Secretary to Edo State Governor

‎[14/11/2024, 15:23:05] Surge: *PSN-YPG IN COLLABORATION WITH THE DIABETES CARE NETWORK ON WORLD DIABETES DAY*
*________________________________________*

🔖Established in 1991 by the International Diabetes Federation with support from WHO in response to growing concerns about the health and economic threat posed by diabetes, World Diabetes Day became an official UN day in 2006.

🔖The World Diabetes Day provides an opportunity to create and raise awareness about diabetes as a critical global public health issue and emphasize the collective and individual actions needed to improve the prevention, diagnosis and management of the condition.

🔖This year’s theme, “Breaking Barriers, Bridging Gaps,” underpins our commitment to reducing the risk of diabetes, and ensuring that all people who are diagnosed with diabetes have access to equitable, comprehensive, affordable and quality treatment and care. 

🔖Join us in raising awareness, spreading knowledge and creating lasting change for all affected by diabetes.

Pharm. Tekena George

[18/11/2024, 13:22:39] Surge: *WHAT IS ANTI-MICROBIAL RESISTANCE(AMR)?*


```🌍 World Antimicrobial Awareness Week 2024 🌍```

_Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) is a growing global health threat that affects us all. When bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites evolve and stop responding to the medications designed to treat them, infections become harder—or sometimes impossible—to cure._ 

[ This means longer illnesses, more expensive treatments, and an increased risk of severe illness or death.]

Today, YPG Edo state join health professionals and professional bodies around the world to advocate and champion safe and guided use of antibiotics. 

The theme of this year is - *Educate. Advocate. Act now!*

*🦠 What Causes AMR?*

•	Misuse of antibiotics, like taking them for viral infections (colds or flu) where they don’t work.
•	Overuse of antibiotics in humans, animals, and agriculture.
•	Incomplete Treatments: Not finishing your prescribed course of antibiotics.


*💊 Why Should You Care?*

•	AMR makes common infections like pneumonia, urinary tract infections, and blood infections harder to treat.
•	It threatens the effectiveness of medical procedures like surgeries and chemotherapy.
•	If we don’t act now, routine infections and minor injuries could become life-threatening.

*📣 How Can You Help?*

•	STOP🛑 the Misuse of Antibiotics Today!
•	Only use antibiotics when prescribed by a certified healthcare professional.
•	Always complete the full course of treatment, even if you feel better.
•	Consult your pharmacist before using any antibiotics.

```Let's work together to spread awareness and #StopAMR!```

*Educate. Advocate. Act now!*

Brought to you by; 

Publicity and Editorial Committee 
*PSN YPG, EDO STATE*

‎[18/11/2024, 21:44:16] Surge: *COMMUNIQUÉ FROM THE PSN-YPG NATIONAL EXECUTIVE COUNCIL (NEC) MEETING*
*__________________________________________*

The PSN-YPG National Executive Council (NEC) comprising of the Central Executive Council (CEC), State Coordinators, and Past Chairmen, convened on 17th November 2024. 

The meeting served as a medium for the CEC to engage with the NEC and deliberate on key matters concerning young pharmacists and the association, with a renewed focus on service and impact.

Following deliberations, the following resolutions were reached:

*🔖Discontinuation of Zonal/Regional Conferences:*

All Zonal Coordinators are directed to discontinue physical zonal/regional conferences. Instead, efforts should be channeled towards driving advocacy and strengthening state chapters within their respective regions.

*🔖Policy document on Minimum Remuneration:*

State Coordinators, in collaboration with Regional Coordinators, are to develop a comprehensive policy document on minimum remuneration for young pharmacists. This document must be finalized by 31st December 2024. Advocacy for its implementation will commence in January 2025.

*🔖Introduction of State Dynamics at the Kano National Conference:*

As part of the upcoming PSN-YPG National Conference in Kano, state chapters will present detailed reports on their activities, achievements, and innovative initiatives.

*🔖Reintroduction of State Performance Awards:*

Awards will be reintroduced to recognize and reward states based on key performance indicators, including advocacy efforts, public health initiatives, membership growth, and active participation in group activities.

*🔖Strengthened Support from the Central Executive Council:*

The Central Executive Council, under the leadership of Pharm. Tekena George, will prioritize supporting state chapters and initiatives spearheaded by State Coordinators to enhance impact and cohesion.

*🔖Virtual Town Hall Meeting:*

A virtual Town Hall Meeting has been scheduled for 30th November 2024. This will facilitate engagement with young pharmacists across the country, providing updates on our administration’s ongoing initiatives and plans.

[19/11/2024, 08:01:27] Surge: *The Danger of Misusing Antibiotics – “Not All Illnesses Need Antibiotics!” 🌐💊*

```Did You Know? Misuse and overuse of antibiotics are two of the main factors driving Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) worldwide. Many people mistakenly believe that antibiotics are a “quick fix” for all types of illnesses, but this couldn't be further from the truth!```

*🛑 What Is Misuse of Antibiotics?*

> Taking antibiotics for viral infections, such as colds, flu, or COVID-19, where they have no effect.

> Using leftover antibiotics or sharing them with others without a prescription.

> Stopping a prescribed antibiotic course halfway through because you “feel better.”
etc. 

*The Impact of Misusing Antibiotics:*

Development of Drug-Resistant Bacteria:

Bacteria evolve and become resistant to the drugs designed to kill them, leading to infections that are harder to treat.
Longer Illnesses and Hospital Stays:

Infections caused by resistant bacteria often require longer and more complicated treatments, sometimes involving stronger and more expensive antibiotics.
Increased Healthcare Costs:

Treating drug-resistant infections is more costly for both patients and healthcare systems.

*Common Misconceptions:*

💬 "Antibiotics can treat any infection."
❌ Fact: Antibiotics only work against bacterial infections. They do not help with viral illnesses like colds or the flu.

💬 "It’s okay to save leftover antibiotics for the next time I get sick."
❌ Fact: Using antibiotics without medical guidance can be harmful and may not target the specific bacteria causing your illness.

*How to Use Antibiotics Wisely:*

> Only take antibiotics when prescribed by a healthcare professional.

> Never use leftover antibiotics or share them with others.

> Complete the full course of antibiotics as prescribed, even if you start feeling better.

> Consult your pharmacist or doctor if you’re unsure whether an illness requires antibiotics.

*📣 Spread the Word! The power to combat AMR lies in our hands. Let’s use antibiotics responsibly and keep them effective for the future.*

🔍 Remember, not all illnesses need antibiotics. Let's work together to stop the misuse and preserve these life-saving drugs for generations to come.

#StopAMR #AntibioticAwareness #AMRWeek2024

[20/11/2024, 09:01:16] Surge: *🌐 Day 3 of World AMR Awareness Week 🌐*

```The Danger of Self-Medication with Antibiotics ⛔️⛔️```

Self-Medication = Increased AMR Risk! ⚠️

_Antibiotics should only be taken when prescribed by a qualified healthcare professional. Self-medication—taking antibiotics without professional guidance—can lead to serious health risks and contribute to the global threat of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)._

🔍 Why Self-Medication is Dangerous:

💊 Wrong Choice of Antibiotic: Different infections require specific antibiotics. Self-medication can lead to the use of the wrong antibiotic, leaving the infection untreated.

💊 Incomplete Dosage: Without professional advice, people often take incorrect doses, which can encourage bacteria to adapt and become resistant.

💊 Unnecessary Use: Taking antibiotics for viral infections, like the common cold or flu, is ineffective and promotes resistance.

🚫 Stop Self-Medication! Always consult a pharmacist or doctor before taking antibiotics. Your health is too important to risk, and proper antibiotic use helps preserve their effectiveness for the future.

#StopAMR #AMRWeek2024 #AntibioticAwareness #ConsultYourPharmacist

Brought to you by; 
The Publicity Team,
PSN-YPG Edo state.

[21/11/2024, 10:43:39] Surge: *🌟 Antibiotic Resistance—It Could Happen to Anyone 🫵!🌟*

Did you know that many common infections are becoming harder to treat due to antibiotic resistance? Conditions like urinary tract infections (UTIs), pneumonia, and skin infections are showing increasing resistance to commonly used antibiotics.

*🔍 Why It Matters:*

💡Limited Treatment Options: Antibiotic resistance means fewer options to effectively treat infections.

💡Longer Illness Duration: Resistant infections can lead to extended sickness and recovery times.

💡Higher Medical Costs: More visits, tests, and treatments are needed to combat resistant bacteria.


*What You 🫵 Can Do:*

```Don’t pressure healthcare professionals for antibiotics—trust their judgment.```

```Complete your prescribed antibiotic course, even if you feel better.```

```Practice good hygiene to prevent the spread of infections.```

Together, we can protect our future by using antibiotics wisely. Consult your pharmacist or doctor before starting any antibiotic.

[22/11/2024, 10:29:54] Surge: *"Finish the Course: Don’t Stop 🛑 Antibiotics Midway!"*

```Stopping antibiotics halfway through a treatment can lead to incomplete recovery and contribute to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). When you don’t finish your antibiotics, some bacteria may survive, becoming stronger and more resistant to future treatment.```

*🌟 Why Finishing Your Course Matters:*

Prevent Resistant Bacteria: Even if you feel better, some bacteria may still be alive. Finishing your antibiotics ensures they are all eliminated.

Avoid Relapse: Stopping early could mean the infection returns, often more severe than before.
Protect Future Health: Proper antibiotic use helps protect your health, your family’s health, and the wider community.

*📝 Tips to Follow:*

📝 Always follow your prescription exactly as directed.

📝 Don’t skip doses—set reminders if needed.

📝 Consult your pharmacist before making any changes to your medication.

_Remember ‼️: Completing your antibiotics is a responsibility to yourself and the community. Let’s work together to stop antimicrobial resistance!_

#AMRWeek2024 #FinishTheCourse #NoToAMR #YPGPharmacists

[22/11/2024, 17:41:38] Wellington: PRESS STATEMENT
For Immediate Release 

November 22nd 2024
Benin City.

Gov Okpebholo suspends recruitment into State civil service 
■Orders review of employments executed since May 2024

■Accuses heads of MDAs of ongoing clandestine recruitment 

Edo State Governor, Senator Monday Okpebholo, has approved the suspension of recruitment into the State’s civil service until further notice. 

The Governor has also ordered for a comprehensive review of all recruitment exercises carried out by the Godwin Obaseki-led administration between May-November 2024.

In a communication notice signed by the Secretary to State Government (SSG), Musa Umar Ikhilor on Friday, the Governor accused heads of various Ministries, Departments and Agencies (MDAs) of carrying out clandestine recruitment exercises into the State’s civil service. 

The notice read: “The Governor of Edo State, His Excellency, Senator Monday Okpebholo is in receipt of report of the clandestine activities being perpetuated by some Commissions, Boards, Parastatals and Agencies of Government in the State. 

“Preliminary investigation reveals that these bodies have continued to issue back dated letters of employment to their cronies without due process.
 

“For the avoidance of doubt, this Administration believes in the principle of fairness and equity which expects that all employment exercise should be merit based, competitive and accessible to all Edo indigenes.

“In light of the foregoing and in order to arrest this ugly trend, the Governor of Edo State, His Excellency, Senator Monday Okpebholo has directed the immediate suspension of all employment processes as well as the review of all appointments carried out since May, 2024 by Commissions, Boards, Parastatals and Agencies of Government.

“Heads of Ministries, Departments and Agencies are to note and comply with the above directive.”

Signed:
Fred Itua, 
Chief Press Secretary to Edo State Governor

*⚽ Weekend Sports Roundup: CAF Awards, Nations League Showdowns, Boxing Drama, Women’s Football Action, and Premier League Rule Changes*


This weekend’s sports scene saw a flurry of activity, from African football excellence to key changes in the Premier League. 


```Here's a look at the top stories:```

*🌍 CAF Awards 2024: Africa’s Best Gear Up for Recognition* 

The countdown to the CAF Awards 2024 is officially on, with the Top Five Men’s Shortlist unveiled. Among the standout nominees are Achraf Hakimi (Morocco / Paris Saint-Germain), Ademola Lookman (Nigeria / Atalanta), Simon Adingra (Côte d’Ivoire / Brighton & Hove Albion), Serhou Guirassy (Guinea / Borussia Dortmund), and Ronwen Williams (South Africa / Mamelodi Sundowns).

In addition to the coveted Player of the Year, several other categories will be celebrated on December 16, 2024, in Marrakech, Morocco:

Goalkeeper of the Year, featuring names like André Onana (Cameroon / Manchester United) and Yahia Fofana (Côte d’Ivoire / Angers SCO).
Coach of the Year, with nominees like Marcel Koller (Al Ahly) and Hugo Broos (South Africa).
Young Player of the Year, spotlighting rising stars such as Karim Konaté (Côte d’Ivoire / Salzburg) and Yankuba Minteh (Gambia / Brighton & Hove Albion).
Awards for Interclub Player of the Year, Club of the Year, and National Team of the Year will also be hotly contested.


*💶Premier League Clubs Approve Changes to Commercial Rules Amid Controversy*

In a major development, Premier League clubs have voted to implement changes to Associated Party Transaction (APT) rules despite strong opposition from Manchester City, Newcastle United, Nottingham Forest, and Aston Villa. The vote, held on Friday in London, saw 16 clubs in favor and 4 against, narrowly meeting the required majority of 14 votes.

The APT rules are designed to prevent clubs from benefitting from sponsorship deals with companies linked to their owners at rates above "fair market value." The recent vote follows an independent tribunal’s ruling, which found some aspects of the previous APT regulations unlawful. Clubs like Manchester City and Aston Villa had called for a postponement, arguing that the amendments needed further clarity.

While some clubs, including Chelsea and Manchester United, supported the changes, Manchester City remains firm in their belief that the new rules are unlawful and may pursue further legal action, indicating that this saga is far from over.

*🏞 Nations League Knockouts: Ronaldo, Mbappé, and Modrić Ready for Action*

The UEFA Nations League is heating up as it moves into the knockout stage, featuring some of football's biggest stars. Cristiano Ronaldo, Kylian Mbappé, and Luka Modrić are set to lead their nations in high-stakes battles, with Europe's top teams vying for a coveted spot in the final. Football fans can expect intense competition as national pride and prestige hang in the balance.

*🥊Amir Khan Advises Joshua to Wait for Fury Showdown*

In the boxing world, Amir Khan has weighed in on Anthony Joshua’s next move, suggesting he should wait for a career-defining clash with Tyson Fury. Joshua, recovering from his knockout loss to Daniel Dubois, is expected to return to the ring in mid-2024. Meanwhile, Fury is preparing for a high-stakes rematch with Oleksandr Usyk, which could set the stage for a blockbuster showdown with Joshua if he triumphs.

*👩⚽️ CAF Women’s Champions League: Edo Queens Battle for Bronze*

Nigerian champions Edo Queens will face Egypt's Masar FC in a third-place match at the CAF Women’s Champions League, aiming to secure a $350,000 prize. Despite their narrow semi-final loss to TP Mazembe, Edo Queens are determined to finish the tournament with a win. Coach Moses Aduku expressed confidence in his team's resolve to bounce back and clinch the bronze medal.

This weekend showcased the drama, excitement, and anticipation that makes sports so captivating, from Africa’s football awards and Nations League clashes to boxing debates and crucial changes in the Premier League's governance. Stay tuned for more updates as these stories unfold!

‎[23/11/2024, 10:33:12] Surge: *WORLD ANTIMICROBIAL RESISTANCE AWARENESS WEEK 2024*
*__________________________________________*

Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) occurs when bacteria, viruses, fungi and parasites no longer respond to antimicrobial agents. As a result of drug resistance, antibiotics and other antimicrobial agents become ineffective and infections become difficult or impossible to treat, increasing the risk of disease spread, severe illness and death.

The World AMR Awareness Week (WAAW) is a global campaign to raise awareness and understanding of AMR and promote best practices among healthcare professionals to reduce the emergence and spread of drug-resistant infections. 

*WAAW is celebrated from 18-24 November every year.*

The theme for the World AMR Awareness Week (WAAW) 2024 is *"Educate. Advocate. Act now*"

AMR is a pressing global health and socioeconomic crisis which significantly impacts human and animal health, food production and the environment.

Drug-resistant-pathogens pose a threat to everyone, everywhere. Yet, much more can be done to raise public awareness. 

Therefore, this year’s theme calls on the global health community to educate individuals on AMR, advocate for bold commitments and take concrete actions in response to AMR.

*Young Pharmacists, let's ACT NOW‼️*

Signed:
*Pharm. Tekena George*
*National Chairman, PSN-YPG*

*Pharm. Precious Umoren*
*National PRO, PSN-YPG*

*Overtaking Military Convoy: Consequences Under Nigerian Law*

*Introduction*

Overtaking a military convoy is a serious offense in Nigeria, punishable under various laws. This article examines the consequences of overtaking a military convoy under Nigerian law.

*Relevant Laws*

1. *The Armed Forces Act (AFA) 2004*: Section 119 prohibits obstructing or interfering with military operations, including convoys.
2. *The Road Traffic Act 2004*: Section 35 prohibits reckless driving, including overtaking military convoys.
3. *The National Security Agencies Act 2004*: Section 15 empowers security agencies to take necessary actions to maintain national security.

*Consequences of Overtaking Military Convoy*

1. *Arrest and Detention*: Security personnel may arrest and detain anyone who overtakes a military convoy.
2. *Prosecution*: Offenders may be prosecuted under the AFA, Road Traffic Act, or National Security Agencies Act.
3. *Imprisonment*: Conviction may result in imprisonment for up to 5 years (AFA) or 2 years (Road Traffic Act).
4. *Fine*: Offenders may be fined up to ₦50,000 (AFA) or ₦20,000 (Road Traffic Act).
5. *Vehicle Confiscation*: The vehicle used to overtake the convoy may be confiscated.
6. *Tort Liability*: Offenders may be liable for damages or injuries caused to military personnel or equipment.

*Court Rulings*

In *Aoku v. State (2017)*, the Court of Appeal upheld a 5-year imprisonment sentence for overtaking a military convoy.

*Precautions*

To avoid consequences:

1. Exercise caution when approaching military convoys.
2. Maintain a safe distance.
3. Follow traffic rules and regulations.
4. Avoid reckless driving.

*Conclusion*

Overtaking a military convoy is a serious offense in Nigeria, carrying severe consequences under various laws. It is essential to exercise caution and respect military operations to avoid prosecution and punishment.

*References*

1. Armed Forces Act 2004 (Cap A20, Laws of the Federation of Nigeria).
2. Road Traffic Act 2004 (Cap R9, Laws of the Federation of Nigeria).
3. National Security Agencies Act 2004 (Cap N14, Laws of the Federation of Nigeria).
4. Aoku v. State (2017) NWLR (Pt. 1578) 214.
